description: A sensitive examination of child sexual assault, based on the case of a girl who was raped in her New Jersey elementary school by another eleven-year-old student.

title: My Boss
description: Founder of Jun Heng Law Firm, Qian Heng, and rookie lawyer, Cheng Yao, go from boss/employee to landlord/tenant in a shared house. They began to rub off on each other in terms of work, life, habits and principles and began to fall in love.

title: Affinity
description: In 2051, bioengineering student Wu Nongyu and sociopath Xie Xinxu are drawn together by a mysterious genetic attraction. As their relationship grows, they must confront their pasts and navigate love, trust, and redemption while racing to find a way to break the powerful bond that threatens to control their lives.

description: A secret grassroots organization persistently fights to expand access to abortion pills across the USA keeping hope alive during a global pandemic and the fall of Roe v. Wade.

title: Ancient Lords
description: Time traveler Meng Qi only wants to be a merry and graceful swordsman, but he suddenly becomes the world-renowned "Mad Monk" in accomplishing his repeated and unlimited mission in the "reincarnation space". However, all this turns out to be planned by a powerful ancient lord. The story tells how the invincible and funny monk makes his way around in the world of martial arts and becomes a legendary swordsman.

title: The Best of Studio C
description: A collection of the Best of Studio C. Come watch your favorite cast members in their greatest and funniest sketches. Playlists are organized by theme, such as Best of Christmas and Best of Back to School.

title: You Are My Secret
description: Lobby manager Xiao Ning and business star Yu Heng share a desire to marry soon. As childhood friends turned colleagues when Yu Heng becomes Xiao Ning's boss they navigate marriage and career together exploring life's meaning as newlyweds.

title: Online Boyfriend is My Boss
description: After a year of online dating with her boyfriend who works abroad, Su Xiaoxiao, who is full of expectations, unexpectedly learn that her new big boss Xu Yanshen turn out to be her online boyfriend. Xu Yanshen keeps asking Su Xiaoxiao to meet offline by message, but Su Xiaoxiao decide to hide the truth out of inferiority.

title: C à vous
description: Host Anne-Elisabeth Lemoine discusses current affairs with her columnist and the guest of the day, while a chef cooks them dinner.

title: Living with Pride: Ruth C. Ellis @ 100
description: Documentary on the oldest known black lesbian activist, who pioneered in creating a safe space for people like herself in the heartland of America.

title: I guerrieri dell'anno 2072
description: In 2072 Rome, Italy, the ruthless CEO of a TV network plots to stage a modern series of gladiator games for ratings while one 'contenstant' learns of a conspiracy behind the true nature of the results.

title: The Dragon King's Hot Valet is a runaway mommy
description: Five years ago, herbalist Cecilia slept with fire-poisoned Dragon King Evander and bore a half-dragon cub, Milo. To afford Milo's suppressant, she disguises herself as a man and becomes the king's manservant. Guarding her secret, she turns rival heiress Willow into a best friend. The king falls for his "male servant" and spirals into jealous self-doubt.

title: Enceinte des Triplés du Roi Dragon (Doublé)
description: Vendue par sa famille à des prétendants violents contre de l'eau magique, Amélie, servante renarde que l'on croyait stérile, tombe enceinte de triplés après une nuit avec un inconnu qui est en réalité le Roi Dragon, Édouard. Tandis qu'il la protège de sa famille, de ses rivaux et de collègues jaloux, une attaque destinée à la tuer révèle qu'elle est la princesse perdue du Clan des Loups à Neuf Queues. Les ennemis tombent ; Édouard la fait sienne comme reine.

title: The Princess and the Werewolf

description: Soon after unemployed graduate Judah Shaw finds himself a penniless scholar in Qirelia, he is forced by the system to win his wives' affection, despite their marriages being purely convenient. To his surprise, among them are a princess, a general's daughter, and a merchant heiress, who bring him not only fortune but also a future brighter than he ever imagined.

title: [Doublé]Sous le Sceau du Pouvoir
description: Estelle Marin et Édouard Valois, confrontés à des conflits de pouvoir et d'émotion, se retrouvent dans un jeu politique complexe. Face à la tyrannie de l'empereur, Estelle s'allie avec le Prince Louis Valois pour renverser le régime et sauver le royaume, tout en naviguant à travers des luttes émotionnelles intenses.

title: [Dubbed]He Is More Than a Driver
description: Colin loves his wife Myra. Yet Myra only cares about her career, so much so that she grows close to her ex for the sake of investment. After all, Colin is just a broke driver. He’s no help to her. But who knows Colin is actually a financial mastermind. He only gave up his empire for love, and not until their divorce does Myra learn this...

title: When Marnie Was There

Inspired by this newfound love, Adrian, a thousand-year seeker of immortality, decides to lead his family on the path to power and eternal life.

But now bound with the sect leader's power, he easily reclaims safety—and starts a rebellion for justice.

title: Looking for Infinity: El Camino

description: After an accident leaves Shen Mo with amnesia, he mistakes Ji Mingxuan, the man who saved him, for his lover. But when Shen Mo regains his memories, the six months they spent loving each other become completely erased. title: The Elf Prince's Mute Mommy
description: Human girl Selena is framed by Elf Queen Walda, causing her to lose her memory and voice. She is sent to the hunter Edmund, who torments her for three years. Elf Prince Lucian searches for his mother after seeing her in his dreams and meets Selena in the forest. When wolves attack, Selena risks her life to protect him, and mother and son recognize each other by the matching flower-shaped birthmarks on their collarbones.

title: Awaken the Infinite Money System
description: In a world where money buys magic, broke Kai Seldon is crushed by billionaire heir Andre Sterling, who owns the Guild and his mother's debt. With Raven’s scheme, Kai turns ledgers into weapons, forces a rematch, and watches a whole Arena pay for a miracle as Sterling's empire collapses. Left with real power, he learns what money can’t buy: the choice to become more is yours alone.

title: Paranormal Highway
description: There are areas in the United States known for mysterious and unexplained phenomena, creating what are called paranormal hot spots. A team of investigators travels the country to experience and document these strange, unexplained events.

title: X-Ray Eyes, Billionaire Rise
description: When poor student Lincoln Cross is hit by campus queen Audrey Sterling, he suddenly gains powerful X-ray vision. His astonishing talent leaves gang heiress Vera Blackwood, stunning sisters Blair Leighton & Amber Collins, and the elegant Audrey Sterling utterly captivated. After all—who wouldn’t want a walking god of wealth? Adapted from a hit web novel.

title: General and I
description: Clever strategist Bai Ping Ting and prince-general Chu Bei Jie of rival kingdoms find themselves torn between loyalty to the country and their passionate love for each other.

title: Love at Dangerous Speeds
description: A runaway bride finds refuge with a charismatic street racer. As their deal turns to love, a devastating connection from their past threatens to shatter their newfound happiness and force her to make an impossible choice.

title: Guess Who I Am [Hindi]
description: Song Yao who never misses a beat in punishing scumbags encounters the fake prince of Chengtian Group. Caught in a Smiths-like battle, the "unremarkable" girl with electrifying eyes and the liar "CEO" begin their story. Legend has it that there's such a person who makes rich scumbags quake in their boots because she never fails to make them suffer the consequences of their actions. This girl's name is Song Yao (Zhang Yuxi). It's all thanks to her fantastic assets in attracting the rich. Any person who is worth hundreds of millions will fall in love with her inextricably as long as he looks into her eyes. Yet no matter how powerful she is, there is a day when she will encounter her Waterloo. Song Yao's eyes fail to work on "Ji Chengchuan" who is the prince of Chengtian Group. Little does she know that this is entirely because the prince in front of him is an impostor named Qin Hao (Wang Ziqi). The meeting of the two "actors" is destined to be explosive.

But the fake bride who entered the mansion as a pawn may become its true mistress, claiming both love and power.

title: Dragon Lord's Reborn Contract Bride
description: Reborn after a brutal betrayal, Elven Princess Eileen vows revenge. She rejects the elite red dragon and chooses Kael, a broken-winged black dragon despised as a useless beast. Everyone mocks her, but on their forbidden wedding night, Eileen’s divine blood awakens Kael’s sealed dragon god core. The crippled beast everyone looked down upon reveals his true identity—the Sovereign Dragon King. Now, the ultimate vengeance begins.

title: Martial Peak [English]

title: Rise of the Invincible Healer
description: A prodigy of cultivation, Dean is trapped at the peak of the Foundation Establishment stage. His master, Aegis, orders him to descend from the mountain to find a woman marked with the "Path Seal", the key to breaking his limits. On his very first night down the mountain, Dean crosses paths with Victoria, CEO of CryoCore Group. By a twist of fate, he becomes her boyfriend, protecting her and her bestie. With unmatched medical skills and martial prowess, he dominates the city, crushes every enemy who crosses him, and rises to the pinnacle of power and success.

title: Legend of Xianwu [English] S1-S2
description: Banished after failing to protect his sect's medicine field, Ye Chen faces betrayal from peers and his lover. A heavenly flame helps him grow stronger as he fights opponents and forges a new path.

title: Legend of Awakening
description: In the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms era, young Lu Ping escapes the wicked forces of Shanhai Tower and discovers his spiritual identity in a moment of enlightenment - or rather, his spiritual identities, as he becomes aware of six distinct souls revolving through his being. When Lu later begins to train and grow under his teacher's masterful guidance, he meets eternal brethren and earns the affection of the young miss Qin along the way. All is going well until a vision reveals his relationship to an unresolved crime in the martial arts world of a decade earlier.

title: Heir of the Hidden Flame
description: Dylan Palmer, Emperor of Corria, has a unique constitution that forbids him from growing close to women. During a visit, Emma Weber—hoping to bear his child and become empress—drugs him, unintentionally involving Nina Greer in her scheme. Nina ends up spending the night with Dylan, but he dismisses the encounter as a mere dream—until six years later, when he meets a child bearing the unique royal birthmark.

title: Rejected by My Family, Feared by the World
description: 21st-century business tycoon Julian Carter is reborn as Gordon Carter’s true son, only to be mocked, rejected, and betrayed by his own family. After being cast out, he starts over with just twenty taels of silver. Using modern knowledge, he builds Silver Works into the kingdom’s top trading house. As his empire rises, the family who abandoned him comes begging—but Julian refuses to look back.

title: The Wrath of Vajra
description: Before the West entered World War II, a Japanese death cult called the Temple of Hades is ordered to aid in the spiritual destruction of China. Their method - abduct their enemies' children and train them as killers for the Emperor. Young Vajra was especially gifted, but swears a secret oath of revenge when his brother dies. Now the greatest assassin in the temple, Vajra escapes to China and begins his quest to protect the innocent, and destroy the ones responsible for making him a living weapon. A former Shaolin monk, martial arts action star Xing Yu (aka Shi Yanneng) stars as Vajra in his first leading role.

title: My Sunshine in the Ruins
description: Orphaned nurse Anna Hill faces life with unwavering optimism, brightening every life she touches—until she meets Elias Black. Hardened by his brutal upbringing in the slums, Elias believes he is living in hell, but Anna's light begins to crack his cold shell.

title: The Epoch of Miyu
description: On her 10th wedding anniversary, Miyu Xu realizes her perfect marriage is a facade and files for divorce. She starts anew as a room attendant at the Purong Hotel, where Feng Ji, now the general manager, returns to his roots. As they face professional challenges, their support for each other grows into romance, leading to personal happiness and the transformation of the hotel into a Shanghai landmark.

title: Boxers Bullied the Gym Cleaner, Never Expecting He Was a 30-Year Boxing Emperor—One Punch, All Down!
description: 🔥 Welcome to VORTEX DRAMA! ⚡ Daily High-Stakes Thrills • Epic Showdowns • Heroes Defying Odds → FOLLOW for Adrenaline-Fueled Adventures! WE DELIVER: 💥 Action | 🕵️♂️ Suspense | 🚀 Sci-Fi/Fantasy | 💪 Heroic Journeys Boxing King Long Taisen wins the Grand Championship, but his defeated rival Green harbors a deadly grudge and murders his father in revenge. Honoring his father’s dying wish, Long Taisen quits the boxing world, seals his immense power with iron rings, and lives in obscurity while raising his daughter, Long Chuchu, alone. Twenty years later, the Long Boxing Gym thrives under Chuchu’s leadership, while the once-legendary champion works quietly as a janitor in his own gym. When the Grand Championship is revived and the nation’s only qualification spot is granted to the Long Gym, Long Chuchu insists on competing—once again facing the ruthless underground fighters from Nanyang. title: Spices of Fate
description: Mandy Jones, a contestant in the modern Master Chef competition, unexpectedly finds herself transported to the olden times as a neglected concubine in the Regal Residence. There, her exceptional cooking skills quickly draw attention, and a romantic connection begins to blossom between her and Prince James Cavill after a series of misunderstandings.

title: Exiled to Emperor
description: Imperial Preceptor Hadrian Hale united Astoria, but after his betrayal by Empress Celia Vale, he was stripped of his titles and exiled. Escaping with 800 loyal guards, Hale crushed her assassins with ease. As enemies attacked from all sides, Hale rallied powerful factions—Northmarch, Huns, and more—defeating the Sunblessed Isle, Sunset Empire, Dragon Empire, and Sultanate of Tutan. He dismantled the Celestial Kingdom and wiped out the Primordia Sect, building an army of millions. Despite the Empress's arrogant attempts to humiliate him, Hale marched on the capital, using his immortal powers to subdue the Imperial Guards, crush her final resistance, and exile her. In the end, he claimed the throne and united the realm.

title: Sweet Combat
description: As the eldest daughter of the Fang Conglomerate, Fang Yu was raised to become the sole successor of the company, yet she goes against her family's wishes to pursue boxing.

title: Commandant, j'épouse quelqu'un d'autre
description: Pendant cinq ans, Irene a aimé le Commandant Carson de toutes ses forces. Elle connaissait ses plannings de vol par cœur, achetait des billets juste pour être sur ses trajets, se réveillait à 2 h du matin pour ses atterrissages, et avait quitté son emploi à Seattle pour le suivre dans une ville où elle ne connaissait personne. Elle croyait qu'il allait la demander en mariage, qu'un jour il poserait un genou à terre dans le terminal sous les acclamations de la foule. Mais Carson ne l'a jamais considérée comme sa petite amie. Pour lui, Irene était pratique : une compagnie chaleureuse, toujours disponible, quelqu'un pour l'entraînement le temps de comprendre ce que voulait une vraie femme. Celle qu'il aimait réellement était Blair, une prostituée qu'il payait entre deux escales. Quand Irene a appris la vérité, son cœur ne s'est pas brisé : il s'est arrêté net. Elle n'a ni pleuré ni crié. Elle a souri, a pris une profonde inspiration, et a dit oui au gentil voisin qui l'aimait en silence depuis des années. Un an plus tard, Carson a découvert que Blair était une croqueuse de diamants impitoyable qui s'était toujours moquée de lui. Ruiné et brisé, il s'est présenté à la porte d'Irene, implorant ma belle qu'il avait jetée. Il arrivait dix mois trop tard. Irene n'a même pas levé les yeux en signant son acte de mariage.

In the early 1980s at a poolside gathering in southern Lebanon Jacob, a Jew of Lebanese extraction, is killed along with a number of his associates by a group of Israelis dressed as Palestinian combatants. Jacob's sister and his daughter Sara survive the attack. The Palestinian combatants realize the goal of the Israelis is to incite public opinion against their struggle so they expose the ones who are really behind the attack. After taking part in an unsuccessful terrorist operation against Abu Khalil and his son Abu Ali, Sara realizes her Israeli fiance designed and executed the plot to kill her father. Israeli soldiers retaliate and arrest a group of Palestinian leaders, including Abu Khalil. After this incident two Palestinian combatants wipe out the Israeli Command Staff in a suicide operation.

title: Umm-e-Haniya
description: A girl with dreams and conviction tries to stand tall in a society where often a decision or dream taken by a woman is not appreciated or acknowledged. Umm-e-Haniya wants to be a cricketer and despite her family and in-laws reluctance she goes for practice to appear in Cricket board test, her dream is to play on National level. She will pass the test and sent away for six months training by the board members, Um- e- Haniya is happy and thrilled to see her dream come true but towards the end of her training week she would pushed by a rival, her injuries will put her on bed rest and eventually she will returned to Karachi. Heartbroken Umm-e-Haniya will spend most of her time in the playground where she initially practiced and one day during her visit she will rescue a newborn abandoned child from the playground and for her family's surprise she wants to keep her and raise her as one of their own. Umm-e-Haniya will face serious allegations and accusations for keeping this child from her Bhabhi and her in-laws but it will not change her decision until her fiancee calls off the engagement. After this incident upon her father's assurance that he takes the responsibility to raise the child Umm-e-Haniya will marry the love of her life. As the story progress we will see her adjust to married life and her struggle to bring the abandoned child to her in-law's place and eventually the kid will live with Umm-e-Haniya. Meanwhile she will face pressure from her in-laws for heir and soon they will find out that Umm-e-Haniya can never give them a child but by this time her husband is fed-up of this life and will divorce her. Umm-e-Haniya's struggle is to raise the abandoned child by herself but girl's biological father would return.

title: Super F***ers
description: A team of super-powered teens use their powers to get high, play pranks, and fight everyone except the bad guys.

title: MTV Big F
description: MTV Big F is a finite television episodic series broadcast by MTV India. It premiered on October 11, 2015, every Sunday. The show brings Gautam Gulati as host and set to deal with youngster's forbidden fantasies by showcasing stories of youngsters in each episode. The second season is hosted by Bollywood actor Randeep Hooda which primarily revolves around the psyche of Indian women to explore their hidden desires.

title: Hurricane F.Y.T.
description: -Montreal (in Canada), 1991. Eleven year old Delphis grew up in a poor neighborhood and an unstable family environment. One night he decides to take control of his life and becomes L'Ouragan (Hurricane). Armed with a lightning bolt on his bandanna and his middle finger held high, he leads his life as he sees fit, in a world that has no place for him. His adventure is like a road trip, from the slums to downtown, from one family to another. In the course of his time on the streets and in his attempts to conquer himself, he finds what's most important: his purity.

title: Entity F
description: We start at Wilfried's home. He is a paragnost who tells us his tale how he became involved with the paranormal. He also tells us that he is willing to help Amber and that this documentary will be his story. Amber has summoned a evil spirit in a abandoned building which has been haunting her ever since. There is only one opportunity to get rid of this evil spirit and that is go back where it all started.

title: F-Listers
description: F-Listers are aspiring actors, the opposite of A-List Actors. Often referred to as laughing-stocks for their dedication to their failed acting careers, in which they forget their age and to pay rent, they are called F-Listers, F for Failure. However, the F-Listers, see it differently; the capital F is for Faith, and perhaps, Faith for future Fame. Mark Star - the self-proclaimed Rock Star; Lizolet - an optimistic Ukrainian Writer who can't spell well; Jimi Choopchick - a lisping wannabe Social Influencer; Cousin Sit - a cross-dressing Model and a bad cab driver, and Mama Star, a cheery BG actress from the heyday Hollywood. They gather with other multi-national actors to make their own movie where every extra has a speaking role.

title: F/X
description: A movie special effects man is hired to fake a real-life mob killing for a witness protection plan, but finds his own life in danger.

title: You're F@#K'n Dead!
description: Two sisters take a wrong turn and find themselves in a strange, forgotten town not found on any map. When the sisters discover the town's true dark nature, they become targets, fighting for their souls against an evil that will never let them leave.

title: Kyûteî Hanî F
description: One night, a man carrying a briefcase is attacked by masked bandits. Cutey Honey narrowly saves him. The man's briefcase, an archaeologist, contains a strange chrysalis that he stole from the Panther Claw organization.

title: Cook F**k Kill
description: Jaroslav K. seems to be a good son, father, and a decent husband. In reality, he is pathologically jealous of his beautiful wife Blanka, and his biggest nightmare is that she and their three kids might leave him one day. Jaroslav K. and his family do not shy away from violence and cheating, which eventually results in a tragedy. This drama about one strange family, scheming, and Jaroslav's efforts to have his way utilizes computer games aesthetics.

title: Mrs. F.
description: Ifeoma Fafunwa, Mrs. F., takes up the challenge of staging her play HEAR WORD! about the abuse of women in male-dominated Makoko, a slum with houses on stilts in the lagoon of Lagos. Besides the original cast of Nigeria's most acclaimed actresses, Ifeoma will cast young women in Makoko who are subject to the same fate as many of the women in Nigeria. Ifeoma connects with them through her personal struggle with her background. Can Ifeoma set a transformation in motion in the heart of the fastest growing city in the world that breaks with the silence culture in Nigeria.

title: FML (F**k My Life)
description: "F.M.L." ("F**k My Life"), is a comedic web series about five friends of color going through a quarter life crisis whilst working in some facet of the porn industry.

title: F(l)ag Football
description: Three teams and their journey to become the next Gay Bowl Champions. With everything on the line, some teams will come together and others will fall apart, but gay sports will never be seen the same way again.

title: F*ck Love Too
description: In this romantic comedy, several friends, each dealing with unhappy love lives, turn to each other for help - but not always with the best results.

description: F For Friends is the story of two unconventional middle age friends who go through life experiences spanning from past to the present. We are searching for distributers and producers to shoot other episodes.

title: Aidan Park: On the F List
description: a young actor comes to Hollywood for fame and finds that its not as easy as he thought. not being the one to allow anything to get in his way Aidan Park will do anything to find the fame that he thinks he deserves.

title: Touboui F
description: Keisuke Fujiki is a genius surgeon who abandoned his name and fled after being falsely accused of murdering his girlfriend. He used the name "Kensuke Narumi" and escaped around Japan while trying to find out the truth behind his girlfriend's death.

title: G
description: Three friends, Robban, Alexander and Kim has just left the compulsory school, and now they consider themselves grown-up and mature, being 16 years old. During the summer holiday they also get a bit of experience of the world: Robban becomes a full-time drug addict, Alexander plays in a rock band but leaves it and Kim is desperate to get the girl of his dreams.

title: Complexe G
description: Le quotidien d'une entreprise, dans une tour à bureaux, où travaillent six femmes au comportement décalé: Karine, la patronne sadique; Nathalie, son adjointe et mère de plusieurs enfants, qui peine à conjuguer travail et famille; Hélène, la moche, dépressive et névrosée; Sarah, la nymphomane; ainsi que Mégan et Méghan, les réceptionnistes fainéantes et peu accueillantes. Chaque épisode permet d'assister aux mésaventures, malaises ou situations rigolotes mettant en vedette les employées de bureau les plus flyées au Québec.

title: G-Loc
description: In a science fiction setting, the film revolves around Bran, who escapes from the cold, uninhabitable earth, and hopes to reach Rhea, which was colonized by humans 582 years ago.

title: Extreme-G
description: Famous rock star Hayko Cepkin is introducing extreme sports around Turkey. Famous guests will do extreme sports such as skydiving, paragliding, scuba diving, motocross, rafting, aerobatic flight.

title: Elite Force
description: France's top-tier police unit, GIGN, tackles high-stakes missions. These elite officers specialize in counterterrorism, rescuing hostages, and safeguarding government VIPs. They're the go-to force when national security is on the line.

title: Sa-rang-i i-gin-da
description: No pain, no gain. This is the motto of the Yoo family: the father is a successful doctor, the mother supervises their daughter's scholastic performance from the vantage point of their beautiful home. Then cracks appear in the facade which soon deepen and spread. In particular, the father seems to be losing control - he is suddenly faced with a sexual harassment lawsuit and an absurd running battle with a taxi driver.

title: After I Left, I Glowed Up!
description: After I Left, I Glowed Up!

title: I Do, I Do
description: A truck driver falls in love with, and is rejected by, a white-collar career woman. Competition arrives from a dashing male colleague.

title: I Forgot I Married Him
description: Following a car crash, Alice can't remember anything-including the betrayal that wrecked her marriage

title: I Wish I Was Like You
description: "I wish I Was Like You" is a documentary about the Nirvana concert that was held in Marino in the Province of Rome on February 22, 1994. But it is also a backwards journey through the '90s, conducted by the two directors, spectators of that era and that memorable event. The Palaghiaccio (Ice Palace) in Marino, where the concert was held, now stands abandoned, dilapidated and sadly destined to become a supermarket. 25 years after Nirvana's last public performances and Kurt Cobain's death, the structure appears as a symbol of decadence but also becomes the point of departure for a celebration of those protagonists and a reflection on that historical period. The general tone is semi-serious, ironic and sacrilegious: the two directors handle the subject of the memory in a light-hearted manner with the aid of personal archival material shot on VHS-C during the many wild nights they spent together when they were kids. The documentary is further enriched by a precious bootleg recording of the Nirvana concert, restored and remastered for the occasion. "I Wish I Was Like You" is a true declaration of love to the filmmakers' youth and its most precious soundtrack: Kurt Cobain and Nirvana.

title: I Capuleti e i Montecchi
description: Bellini's radiant retelling of Shakespeare's Romeo and Juliet is a beacon in the bel canto tradition. San Francisco Opera's co-production features two of the greatest voices in bel canto together for the first time: mezzo Joyce DiDonato and soprano Nicole Cabell. Their compelling duet is one of the finest marriages between two voices in many, many years. The production, directed by Vincent Broussard and featuring costumes by Christian Lecroix, is captured in brilliant HD.

title: I want and I will
description: A well-known psychologist, Mikhail Labkovsky, writer and host will try to help viewers to accept themselves, to love life, and to become happy. His book "I want and I will!" became a real bestseller with a circulation of 1.5 million copies

title: Juan Gabriel: I Must, I Can, I Will
description: A tribute showcasing rare archives and personal narratives about the iconic Mexican singer.

title: I Do, I Do
description: Hwang Ji An is the top shoe designer in a major shoe company. She is in her 30s, successful and single. One night, she makes a horrible mistake and sleeps with Park Tae Gang, a good-looking new employee in her company, and she finds out she is pregnant. Ji An's hard-earned career and her stylish lifestyle threatens to implode as a result of her one-night-stand mistake. Will Ji An be forced to give up everything and live with the consequences of her mistake?

title: Saber Marionette J [English]
description: The male-only planet of Terra II is populated by clones of the six men who were marooned there 300 years before. The only females are robots called "marionettes," who serve as workers and soldiers. Japoness marionettes Lime, Cherry, and Bloodberry are different from most others, because each possesses a special circuit that gives them human emotions. One by one, they are accidentally awakened by young Mamiya Otaru and take up residence with him. As a result, Otaru's uneventful life becomes just a tad more interesting. At the same time, conflict between Japoness and the city-state of Gartland is escalating. Is it because Faust, the leader of Gartland, lusts for world domination, or is it something else his heart longs for... something with a connection to Lime, Cherry, and Bloodberry?

description: This documentary follows the rise of a promising young singer songwriter as she meets with record executives, plays showcases and hones her craft. Over a three year period Sarah logs video diary entries that chronicle her feelings dealing with homophobia, self image and dreams of a record deal. As a child Sarah often wondered why she felt like a boy in a girl's body. Candid conversations with Sarah and her teenage friends give the viewer an intimate glimpse into the experience of coming out as a gay teenager. The viewer is shown the upside of pursuing one's dreams with the footage of Sarah's big break opening for international recording star K'naan as well as an even bigger show at an outdoor festival performing for a huge crowd. There are also many low points in Sarah's career throughout the three year span that make her question if she has made the right choices. This is a film about hope and possibility but also about redefining success when life doesn't give you everything you hoped for.

title: Cajun Renaissance Man: Dudley J. Le Blanc
description: This fascinating film is the biographical story of Senator Dudley "Coozan Dud" Le Blanc, one unique man with three sides -- a major player in Louisiana politics for over 50 years, the Founding Father of the Cajun Renaissance Movement and a marketer extraordinaire of the best-selling American patent medicine in the 1950's, HADACOL. Coozan Dud's fame exploded when he marketed his patent medicine across the country on his HADACOL train filled with Hollywood stars, comedians, country music legends and famous athletes -- Mickey Rooney, Bob Hope, Judy Garland, Lucille Ball, Dorothy Lamour, Jimmy Cagney, Burns and Allen, Groucho, Hank Williams, Minnie Pearl, Carmen Miranda, Jack Dempsey and many more. Groucho Marx invited Le Blanc on his TV show "You Bet Your Life" and asked, "What is HADACOL good for?" To thunderous audience applause, Dudley answered in his humble Cajun way, "It was good for $5 million for me last year." Though he passed in 1971, Dudley "Coozan Dud" Le Blanc is truly a living legend.

title: Doroga k schastyu
description: Anya Kalinina has dreamed of becoming a doctor since childhood. In preparation for entering medical school, Anna works part-time at the post office to help her grandmother a little. Kolya, the son of a local businessman Volkov, has long and hopelessly been in love with Anya. Once a cadet of the Academy of the Ministry of Emergency Situations Artyom comes to visit the girl's neighbor, and Anya falls in love for the first time. Young people spend several days together and agree to meet in a month, so as not to part ever again. But a series of tragic events disrupt their plans.

title: Pristupit k likvidatsii
description: Spring 1945. The end of World War II is approaching. In Western Belarus, near Grodno, there is a gang headed by a hardcore criminal, a former accomplice of the Germans, Boleslav Kruk. At the same time, the corpse of a certain Sudin was found in Moscow, who turned out to be a repeat offender named Mordyonok. Investigating his death, the operative group of the Moscow Criminal Investigation Department, headed by Colonel Ivan Danilov, enters a former military pilot Chistyakov (aka Altunin), who has become a deserter and accomplice of bandits, connected with Mordyonok and Boleslav Kruk.

title: Kadhal Pagadai
description: Kadhal Pagadai revolves around middle-class families in Konar Colony, in Chennai, in the late 1990s. The show showcases the struggles revolving in middle-class families and the youngsters love live, through emotional outbursts, with comic reliefs here and there. Though there is no main characters, the story mainly revolves around a family living in Konar Colony. The family is led by Mohanbabu, a clerk in a government office, though his wife Vanja is the one leading the family as the only woman. Mohanbabu younger brother, Rajbabu, is a clerk in a chit fund company. He has a girlfriend named Sithara, who is an orphan. Rajbabu hides this fact from his family, as he want to settle first before marrying Sithara. But Sithara's flashback from her college days involving Ramana, forces Rajbabu to introduce her to his family, and his elder sister, Girija gets an instant dislike for Sithara. Girija comes down to Chennai from Saudi, seeking money from her brothers, to release her husband from jail back in Saudi. At the same time, Rajbabu losses the chitfund money, due to a sinister plan laid by his office peon, Sanjeevi. Ramana comes forward to offer money to help Rajbabu and Sithara but has a condition that Sithara should stay with him in his Cunnor Estate for 10 days. If Sithara stills loves Rajbabu after their mutual stay, Ramana would not trouble them anymore. Having faith in Sithara and desperately in need for money, Rajbabu convinces a reluctant Sithara to go with Ramana. But soon, his faith turns into a possessive behavior and Rajbabu refuses to trust Sithara. Though, this is the main gist of the plot, Kadhal Pagadai also revolves around other families in the Colony. One such family is the ultra rich and arrogant woman who bought the house that she stayed in. A strict old man with 2 daughters, who is the only man in the colony to have a telephone, which irritates him as he has to pass messages to the people in the colony. His elder daughter, Nandhini who loves her neighbour, a mechanic and the duo runs away when her father opposes. A Palakad Brahmin family, who is one of the main comic relief in the show. A disabled helper around the colony, named Ayyappan. A struggling cinema actor, also a fraud, with whom Sithara's friend Sundari was in love with, but breaks up after knowing his fraudulent nature. How all these families overcome their daily challenges? Would Ramana win Sithara's heart? Or would Rajbabu and Sithara unite again? forms the climax.

title: Vasantham Vanthachu
description: Kumaresan (Venkat Prabhu) is a milk vendor in his village, who hates the marriage and stays away from women. His elderly father (Velu Thigal) wants him to get married as soon as possible, but the Kumaresan stubbornly refuses to get married. During the college holidays, the city girl Gayathri (Nanditha Jennifer) comes to stay with her grandparents Chettiar (Shanmugasundaram) and Meenakshi (Varalakshmi). After initial clashes between Kumaresan and Gayathri, Gayathri is intrigued by its refusal to get married. In the past, Kumaresan's brother got secretly married to a woman from a rich family. Kumaresan's family welcomed him and were happy for them. The young Kumaresan clashed with his sister-in-law, therefore the young couple left their home. Kumaresan fell sick after the departure of the couple, then Kumaresan and his father begged Kumaresan's brother to call on their mother (Sabitha Anand) but his sister-in-law refused to let him go. Before she died, Kumaresan's mother Chellamma asked Kumaresan to not be like his brother and to stay with his father. That day, Kumaresan took the decision of remaining single. Meanwhile, Gayathri falls in love with Kumaresan. Gayathri then tied the mangala sutra to herself and lied to the villagers that Kumaresan is the one who tied the knot. Gayathri's grandparents and Kumaresan's father agree for their marriage. Kumaresan doesn't want to live with her, so he tries several ways to drive Gayathri out of his house. Afterwards, the village doctor Rajasekhar (Ramji), who knows about the matter, establishes the truth at the village court and the couple split up. Gayathri then goes to back to her parents. Kumaresan, who felt alone, realises that he was in love with Gayathri but it was too late. The film ends with Gayathri returning to his home and they immediately get married.

title: M
description: M is a work of art that explores the relationship between sexuality and death. These two appear to be opposite forces, but in fact they merge in all of us, disguising the fear of death or the desire to die, the world of Eros and Thanatos. In M the character of Marilyn Monroe should be seen as a symbol of this interpenetration. The actress's death is as famous as her sexuality and thus sets a perfect example of how the ancient bond between sex and death is being forever mystified and exploited by the popular culture. M attempts to explore this phenomenon in a much more personal level. All the events in the work are fictional and they are set in no particular place or time. The work consists of film material that has been produced on and off in a time period of four years, beginning in March 2013 to December 2017. The footage was shot mainly in the home and grounds of Casa das Musas Art House in Nazare, Portugal. Other shooting locations were Litibu village in Mexico and Uusikaupunki, Finland. All the actors in the work are non-professionals and were chosen because of their strong essence and character. Although the work is based on a script the roles and events were adjusted to fit the actors presence, and all of the dialogue was acted by the artist herself as voiceover. At times the process of filming was on the verge of improvisation and therefore only the afterwork would fully determine how some of the scenes developed. This way of working turned out to be a crucial element of the work. M is not an attempt to tell a story or redefine a character. In fact it is quite the opposite. The elements of film are being used as pathways for the artist to move in and out of the characters, each character representing somewhat a side of the artists own fantasy. By placing herself in the part of an object of fantasy the artist strives to understand the unity of sex and death, not merely as a myth in popular culture, but as an integral part of humanity.

title: Mama/M.A.M.A.
description: From the Academy Award[TM]-nominated and Emmy Award[TM]-winning producer of "Waco: The Rules of Engagement" and the Academy Award[TM]-nominated writer/director of "Death on the Job" comes "Mama/M.A.M.A.: Munchausen Syndrome by Proxy." "Mama/M.A.M.A." is the provocative investigation of Munchausen Syndrome by Proxy, a perplexing psychological disorder where a mother secretly but deliberately harms her child in order to get the sympathy and praise of others and the attention of the medical community. What emerges over three years of scrutiny are disturbing questions related to the medical profession's arrogant use of the diagnosis, the possible contribution from the pharmaceutical industry, and its grievous impact on families. Questions addressed in this film include: Is this syndrome an authentic phenomenon or is it a witch hunt? What are the moral implications of a society that fails to question the science behind the disorder, blindly lending faith to its sensational existence? The deeply disturbing "Mama/M.A.M.A." closely follows three cases, allowing the audience to absorb all points of view and determine who the real abusers are. (Florida Film Festival)

title: Discovering the I&M Canal
description: In this documentary shows the journey by bicycle, helicopter, and car from Chicago to LaSalle on this 19th century canal, which is the last link of canals and waterways connecting the east to the Mississippi River down to the Gulf of Mexico. This canal was the 'super highway' of its day. Although it was well known at the time, most people today don't know what the I & M Canal is, much less its history. In this video, some of the industries along the canal are spotlighted and also how it was used as a sewer for Chicago. This canal helped make Chicago what it is today - little known facts about Lincoln's debate.

title: Dial M for Murder
description: Anthology of crime stories in which the telephone plays a key role.

title: N/949
description: A drug-abuse tragedy affected to Marco, Luka's best friend. Luka felt guilty about that. That's why he decided to begin an outsider lifestyle in a society where nobody can breath.

title: Neal 'n' Nikki
description: Take a joyride with Neal and Nikki as they travel all across Canada to find what they want most. And it's going to be quite a trip.

title: Eggs 'n' Baker
description: Saturday morning children's cookery series, presented by Cheryl Baker.

title: B'hike n BASE
description: This adventure is a unique experience, a journey that combines cycling and base Jump which has never been done before. Adventurer and base jumper Francky Malleus who is 27 and from France, will spend a month and a half on his bike carrying only his camping gear and base jumping equipment on his cargo rack to go jump from the cliffs of the Alps.

title: Vostok n 20
description: Daily life in a third-class Transsiberian wagon named Vostok N 20. Between discomfort, shared meals, boredom and confessions to strangers, people spend their time as they can. In the form of literary counterpoint, poems of Marina Tsvétaeva told by Fanny Ardant illuminates the feelings of passengers: their loneliness, their desires for freedom and love.

title: Nikki & Nora: The N&N Files
description: The N&N Files follows New Orleans locals Nikki Beaumont (Liz Vassey) and Nora Delany (Christina Cox) as they juggle the inner-workings of their personal lives with their roles as private investigators in America's oldest party town.

title: Bldg. N
description: A college student, Shiori, visits an abandoned apartment complex in a provincial city, which is famous for its rumors of hauntings, out of curiosity along with Keita and Maho, who also attend the university. However, there are numerous residents there. As Shiori and her friends begin to investigate, they suddenly experience a violent "bizarre rap phenomenon" and a resident jumps to his death right in front of them.

title: Rock 'n' Roll
description: Passionate rock'n roll dancer, Rodolfo has his partner Ornella as a partner. Frozen by the frivolous behavior of the boy, however, the young girl no longer wants to learn to dance with him.

title: Cowgirls 'n Angels
description: A group of rodeo trick-riders recruits a young girl to join them.

title: King 'n' Me
description: An eccentric millionaire sends a documentary film crew on a search to find the most legendary icon in the history of rock n roll...The King. Is he alive, as many believe? If so, does he want to be found? Is there any credibility to the often ridiculous tales of sightings? What they soon find will not only change their careers, but also their lives.

title: Nelsons N 5
description: World-renowned conductor Andris Nelsons, music director of the Boston Symphony Orchestra, arrives in Amsterdam to conduct Shostakovich's powerful 5th Symphony before the city's renowned Royal Concertgebouw Orchestra.

title: Fame N Fishin'
description: Fishing guide Robin Rebman and singer songwriter Earl 'Peanutt' Montgomery take country music stars for fishing, conversation and singalongs along the Tennessee River.

title: The N Word
description: A documentary looking at the N word.

title: 'n Shrink
description: Dr. Jerry, a psychiatrist, starts an online counseling group for web addicts.

title: Kit N Sam
description: Sam and Kit have been a faithful couple going-steady for two years. They get engaged. About a week before their marriage, Kit comes up with a proposition, which she thinks will keep their marriage a success forever. She tells Sam that till marriage they should go out and taste the forbidden fruit of infidelity, so that they don't have any desire for other men/women after marriage - after much hesitation, Sam agrees to her proposal A hilarious turn of events ensue through the misadventures of Kit and Sam as they go about trying to have affairs with other men and women - until they realize what true love is.

title: Zone(n)050
description: In Ledeberg - "Police zone 050" - there is a group of young people that met each other at Keizerpark or Centrumplein. Some say they are drug users, dealers, or commit crimes - A one sided story. In zone(n)050 these young people get a voice to tell us their side of the story. About the problems they have had to deal with, about how difficult it can be to grow up and stay on the right path, and about their dreams. Still one sided, but just as true. Zone(n)050 is a documentary about suns, sometimes absent fathers and amazing mothers.

title: Lance N' Masques
description: Yotaro Hanafusa is a descendant of the "Knights of the World." With the Knight's Code of Chivalry hammered into him since childhood, Yotaro cannot stop himself from saving damsels in distress. He wears a mask, and is known on the street as "Knight Lancer" but he has always kept his identity a secret. While on an outing, Yotaro saves a 6-year-old girl, Makio Kidoin, the only child of a powerful business tycoon. When Yotaro discovers that Makio leads a lonely life in a huge estate, he resolves to protect her. He and his friends disguise themselves as lodgers and move into her mansion.

title: It's Showtime
description:
Bumilis ang pintig ng puso ng kababaihan sa studio dahil sa pagdating ng mga gwapo. P-Pop group na AJAA, pinakilig ang mga tao, 'yung kilig na may halong kaba kapag si crush ay nasa tabi mo na. They performed their single "Kakabakaba," na perfect background music kapag nakikita ang taong nagpapabilis ng heartbeat mo.

Hindi pwedeng umatras ang mga beki na kinakabahan kapag oras na ng talakan. Panibagong linggo ng Miss Q and A, sinimulan nina Marjorie Lopez Buenaobra, Jov Prado, at Babyloves Monroe Solito.

Astig ang kandidatang si Marjorie na game mag-dance exhibition with buwis-buhay moves. Aray mo, bhie! Doble naman ang pressure na nilabanan ni Babyloves sa entablado dahil sumali na rin ang sa Miss Q and A ang boyfriend niya at umuwing panalo. Kaya biro ni Jhong Hilario, parang 'niraket' ng mag-bebe ang Miss Q and A. 

Sumakses si Marjorie sa unang round at sumalpak sa Wit Lang kung saan nabunot niya ang tanong na, "Bakit tuwalya ang laman ng goto, at hindi bimpo?" Naka-face off niya si Jov na naging witty rin as she 'talak-ed' sa nabunot na question, "Bakit magaan lang ang hibe?" 

Bumuhos ang emosyon sa Laro Laro Pick game arena sa mva kuwento ng katatagan at pagmamahal na ibinihagi ng Madlang Solo Parents mula NCR.

Bumilib ang Madlang People sa laki ng pagmamahal ni Danny sa mga anak, pati sa matibay nitong pananampalataya. Mahirap man daw ang buhay pero sisikapon ng biyudong si Danny na itaguyod ang pag-aaral ng mga anak.

Very beautiful naman ang smile ni Eve sa kabila ng madilim na pinagdaanan sa kamay ng dating asawa. Eh, kung ready na siya na muling buksan ang puso, si Ogie Alcasid may irereto.

Ang swerte ay kumapit kay player Nelle, na hindi rin napigilan ang luha nang ikuwento ang pinagdaanan bilang ina. Matapos umuwi mula Taiwan, kung saan sya nagtrabaho at nanganak, bigla na lang tumigil sa pagsusustento ang ama ng kanyang anak.

Naging praktikal si Nelle at tinanggap ang Li-Pot offer. Tama kaya ang kanyang desisyon? 

#ShowtimeNovemberGV
#ItsShowtimeFullEpisode 
#ABSCBNEntertainment

title: Miss Q&A: Mga pamahiin sa pagsali sa pageants
description:
Sa dami ng nangyayari sa paligid, kailangan natin ng good news at good vibes para i-reset ang ating isip. Dito sa "It's Showtime," happiness overload ang mga eksenang mapapanood.

Isang pagbati ang ipinarating ng It's Showtime family sa 21-year-old world tennis champion na si Alex Eala, na gumawa ng kasaysayan sa mundo ng tennis matapos makuha ang kauna-unahang WTA title para sa Pilipinas nang talunin niya si world No. 3 Jessica Pegula ng United States sa 2026 Mubadala DC Open, na ginanap sa Washington D.C.

Mula sa isang alamat sa mundo ng sports, isang alamat sa larangan ng P-Pop din ang bumisita. Sinimulan ng P-Pop favorite Alamat ang episode with a performance of their track, "Sinigang," na inihain ng grupo specially for you!

Bawal ang nega, pero welcome dito si Negi, ang guest co-host of the day, na join sa pakikipagkulitan nina Jhong Hilario at Ogie Alcasid sa Miss Q&A candidates.

May pasok, as in pasok sa banga ang wit at pagrampa nina Miss Q&A Cheska Deyn, Leo Castillo, at Angelbert Castill. At pasok sa banga ang mga paandar nila't special skills. Sina Cheska at Angelbert ang umabante sa Round 2, Wit Lang, kung saan sagot nila'y sure na sure, showing grace under pressure.

Hindi suspended ang swerte sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Sumugod s rumaragasang god vibes at papremyo ang Madlang Players mula Pamplona, Las Pinas City.

Kapag 'Kim' ang pangalan, maganda talaga ang ngiti n'yan! Dahil sa magaan na awra ni player Kim, isang 21-year-old daddy, nag-enjoy ang hosts na makipagkuwentuhan sa kanya tungkol sa trabaho't pamilya.

Enjoy rin ang Madlang People sa libreng 'sine' sa FUNanghalian. Sa Act-Song portion ng You Gotta Lyric round, may horror at comedy, at may kilig hatid ng tambalang DaCKie!

title: It's Showtime
description:
Kung may isang alamat na hindi nakakasawang balik-balikan, ito 'yung alamat na masarap panoorin habang sila'y kumakanta at nagsasayawan. None other than P-Pop group, ALAMAT, na nagbabalik ang grupo sa 'It's Showtime' studio para i-perform ang Luzviminda,

Walang basaan dito pero bubumuhos ang swerte at good vibes kasama ang mga taga-San Juan City (na kilala sa 'Wattah Wattah' Festival) sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena.

Naglaro rin sina Teddy Corpuz, Darren Espanto, Jackie Gonzaga at Ryan Bang. Si Jackie lang ang nakatawid sa 'You Gotta Lyric,' kung saan tama naman ang sagot niya, pero pabirong idineklarang "wrong" ni Jhong Hilario dahil sintunado. To the rescue naman si Darren para itama ang tono! Dackie moment na ‘to!

Samantala, na-touch ang Showtime hosts sa kuwento ng buhay ni Wo, isang delivery rider na laki sa lolo. Habang itinataguyod ang sariling pamilya, gusto rin niyang maibalik ang sakripisyo ng lolong nagpalaki sa kanya. Samantala, 'extra' ang banter nina Kim Chiu at Jhong na nauwi pa nga sa dilatan ng mga mata. At syempre, kanya-kanya silang entry ng jokes tungkol sa pangalan ni Wo!

Very good din si Tate, ang tricycle driver na sweet lover kay misis, at may malasakit din sa kapwa. Minsan na niyang pinatunayan ang kabutihan nang ibalik ang gamit na naiwan ng pasahero. Kaya ang madlang girls sa studio, na-in love kay Tate! 'Yun nga lang, si misis, umapela, "Sorry po, married na!"

Luck ay na-attract ni Margo, ang hairstylist na 'di nauubusan ng kuwento. Pati tungkol kina Ogie Alcasid at Anne Curtis, meron siyang 'chismis.' At shoutout sa mga ex niya, hanggang tingin na lang daw kayo sa kan'yang ganda! Umabot sa P35,000 ang Li-Pot offer, na tinanggap ni Margo. Tama ang pinili ate n'yo dahil nang subukan niya ang P350k Pot question, akala niya'y 'simple' lang pero hindi pala niya alam ang kasagutan.

It's time for Region 1 to shine sa second week ng ika-10 taon ng "Tawag Ng Tanghalan."

Ang unang kalahok ay mula Laoag City, si Jeanel Silvestre, na nagpamalas ng husay sa entablado, singing Juan Karlos ‘JK’ Labajo's "Demonyo." Katulad ng idol na si JK, nagsusulat din ng kanta si Jeanel, na bet 'piratahin' ni Ogie nang magustuhan ang sample ng self-composition nito. Speaking of songwriting, may tip si Ogie tungkol d'yan.

Ang awit daw ay hinuhugot sa sariling kuwento, parang si Louie Ocampo, na binuo ang "Tell Me" mula sa sariling karanasan. Binalikan din ng 'Showtime' family ang iba pang iconic songs na nilikha ng maestro. Proud din si Ogie dahil komposisyon ng kanyang kaibigan

ang napiling bagong theme song ng isang airline. Chika niya, isa siya sa napakaraming tinalo ni Sir Louie sa paggawa ng theme song na 'to.

Samantala, napabilib ni Jeanel sina hurado Jonathan Manalo, Bituin Escalante, at Maestro Louie. Para sa kanila, strength ni Jeanel ang pagiging chill nito, at ang magandang tone.

Mula Pangasinan, lumuwas si Shekinah Barbiran to chase her dream sa tanghalan. "Ikaw Ay Ako" ni Klarisse De Guzman ang napili niyang sandata sa laban ng bosesan. At 15, 'beterano' na siya sa pagsali ng contests. Dahil seasoned kontesera, nakita ng hurados ang pagiging relaxed niya.

Nagustuhan ng hurados ang dalawang nagtanghal pero isa lang ang aabante sa susunod na round, at ito ay si Jeanel na nakakuha ng markang 91% laban sa 89.3% ni Shekinah.

title: Okay pa ba 'to? Vice, kinabahan kay Medusa | It's Showtime
description:
Ihanda ang damdamin, musika niya ay damhin. Si "PBB Gen 11" ex-housemate Dylan Yturralde na ang bahala sa kiig playlist mo today. Nagkuwento rin si Dylan tungol sa kanyang music journey at paano siya na-inspire ni OPM icon Rico Blanco.

Sabi nila, respect your elders, kaya saludo tayo sa mga seniors na sa dami ng karanasan ay matatawag na certified life achievers. This Thursday sa Miss Q and A segment ng "It's Showtime," nagkasukatan ng seniority at timeless wit at beauty.

Ang ating senyoritang sosyal at elegante, rumampa sa Miss Q&A, walang iba kundi si Señora Danica Parong Evidente. Sa isang titig niya baka ikaw ay matulala, walang kupas ang karisma ni Medusa Valentina Galema. At kayo na raw ang humusga kung tao ba o hayop si candidate Exotic Tayop.

Biro ng hosts, tatawagin nating "Miss Q and A" Senior Edition ang segment for today's video dahil may twenty percent discount na ang mga 'lola' n'yo. Pero sa kulitan, full price ang tawanan. May aral din na mapupulot tungkol sa mga pangarap na hindi dapat ibaon na lang sa limot. Dahil age is just a number, pero ang 'slayable' attitude will last forever.

Sa pagtitinda ng laruan, bata ang madalas nilang pinasasaya. Pero sa araw na 'to, sila naman ang nabigyan ng ligaya sa game arena. Toy sellers mula NCR ang bumida sa Laro Laro Pick.

Si player Ria, never paglalaruan ang puso ng nobyong si Eric. At never niya itong ipagpapalit kahit kanino, kahit kay Ralph de Leon pa! Biceps at makinis na kutis ni Ralph, hindi umubra!

Dahil walang naka-survive sa mga challenges, bumunot ng lucky player na aabante sa jackpot round, mga bes. Si Liza ang pinabalik sa game arena para sa chance na maiuwi ang malaking kwarta!

title: Vhong at Ogie nagkapikunan sa mainit na puksaan
description:
Oooh lala-van na lavan ang pitik ng bewang nina Baby Dolls Arianne, Chloe, Johaira, Juby, Jelai, Eriel, and Ina. To welcome their era as an official P-Pop group at kauna-unahang Hype Group ng bayan, ginanap ang Baby Dolls Day.

Present ang mga social media personalities, Kapamilya at Kapuso "PBB" ex-housemates, beauty queens, P-Pop groups, "Tawag Ng Tanghalan" alumni, "Showtime Online U" hosts, at All-Star Games Basketball at Volleyball Team para makigiling.

Pagkatapos ng Baby Dolls Day celebration, bumida naman ang beki na may talak para sa buong nation. Meet CY ng Quezon City, Fema Braganza ng Pangasinan, at BRIGIT ng Laguna, ang mga talakera na sumubok masungkit ang korona sa Miss Q and A.

Minsan ang talak, may pagka-harsh, parang comment ni Ogie Alcasid, na hindi inurungan sa puksaan si Vhong Navarro. Kaya ang ilong ni Vhong, napuruhan sa laitan!

Naloka naman ang Madlang People sa sagot ng mga kandidata sa unang tanong sa Tumpak Ganern tungkol sa karakter sa Noli Me Tangere na sinasabing ama ni Maria Clara. Ang sagot ni BRIGIT, "Nutridamus!" Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kapatid ba 'yan ni Nutri Bun?

Sina Fema at CY ang umabante sa next round ng chukchakan, ang Wit Lang. Pagkatapos ng talakan, ang very 'pulchritudinous', sabi ni Brent Manalo, na si CY ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Pumadyak ang swerte at good vibes para sa mga pedicab driver na sumalang sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakaka-touch ang pagiging solid Showtimer ni Tatay Doms, na may iniabot pang liham ng pasasalamat para kay Vice Ganda at sa buong "It's Showtime" family. Pero, si Kim Chiu, nagtampo, dahil wala ang pangalan niya sa sulat na ito.

Pagkatapos ng aktingan, iisa lang ang naka-survive sa laro! Ito ay si Mavin, na kahit mahirap man ang buhay ay nananatiling masayahin. Kapang P300k ang napasakanya, babawi siya sa magulang niya. Pero sapat nang pambawi ang P40,000 na Li-Pot offer kaya dito na siya sa siguradong uuwi siyang panalo.

title: Vice, tinapatan ang talak nina Andrea at Jers sa Miss Q&A
description:
Dedma sa ex na kumakatok at may pasalubong na paulit-ulit na pasakit. But, hello sa grupong nagbabalik sa "It's Showtime" entablado para pagandahin ang araw n'yo. Napaindak ang buong nation sa performance at taas ng energy ng P-Pop group VXON.

Dazzling sa pagrampa sina Miss Q and A Resbakulawan candidates Andrea Jane Peralta, Jers Sabado, at Mama Dhel. Dahil Resbakulawan, diretso nang sumalang ang tatlo sa Wit Lang. Pagkatapos, sina Andrea at Jers ang umabante sa BEKLAMATION.

Na-impress si hurado Nicole Cordoves, pero aminadong nakulangan nang kaunti sa 'chukchak' ng dalawang ladies. Kaya para iwas-bitin, pati si Vice Ganda ay tumalak na rin! Sa huli, itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era Resbakulawan daily winner si Andrea.

Hindi na kailangan pang tumama sa lotto para masabing lucky sa araw na 'to! Dahil swerte agad ang lumapit sa mga taga-San Isidro, Cainta Rizal na bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena sa "It's Showtime."

Walang mapapagod kakatawa sa mga challenges sa game arena. Sa paboritong Act-Song portion sa You Gotta Lyric round, time-out muna sa kilig scenes sina Brent Manalo at Jackie Gonzaga dahil magkapatid muna sila sa isang eksena ng family drama.

Hindi naman horror story ang pagsali ni player Pao. Dahil matapos ma-eliminate, nabunot ang pangalan niya upang maglaro sa jackpot round dahil bigo ang mga naunang players na ma-secure ang spot.

Ramdam ni Vice Ganda ang matinding pangangailangan ni Pao, isang siomai vendor na nag-iipon para sa kanyang operasyon sa mata dahil sa kondisyon na keratoconus. Ramdam din nito ang puso ng manlalaro. Kaya para bang binigyan niya ito ng lakas ng loob na sugalan ang POT question.

Pigil ang hininga ng Madlang People at lahat ng nasa studio, hanggang sa isinigaw ni Pao ang sagot. Bumuhos ang emosyon at saya nang i-anunsyo ni Vice Ganda na tama ang sagot ni Pao at maiuuwi nito ang P350,000 POT money.

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Sa pag-ibig, maraming tanong na walang kasagutan. Mapapasabi ka na lang ng, "Hindi ko alam." 'Yan ang hugot ng bandang Spongecola at ni Kai Del Rio sa pagsasanib ang kanilang mga musika't talento.

Sa Miss Q and A, talak ay hindi bitin. Busog sa wit ang mga kandidata for today's video, sina Sashi Giggle Esmeralda, Zha-Zha Divah, at Angel Grey, in their rampa and chukchak na havey.

Si Vice Ganda, namasa ang kili-kili sa daming ganap this Wednesday. From bardagulan to kantahan, parang never-ending ang kulitan. Masarap din balikan ang tamis, pati na ang pait, ng unang pag-ibig. Ang usapang crush at rejection, idaan na lang natin 'yan sa karaoke session! Kapag ba galing sa vacay, talagang unlimited ang energy? Ayun, muntik na namang mag-OT sina Meme!

Sa hinaba-haba ng mga pata-WOW, sa Tumpak Ganern round pa rin ang tuloy. Ang comeback-ing kandidata na si Sashi, bigo na pumaslak muli. Samakatuwid, sina Angel at Zha-Zha ang nagsalpukan sa Wit Lang.

Sobrang init ng panahon. Ang haring araw, talagang umeeksena! Pero mas mainit ang swerte sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Mula drawing, magkatotoo kaya ang dream 'winning' ng mga Architecture students mula NCR?

"Woke up like this" ang peg ni Kyle in his kulot-kulutan hairdo. Ano nga ba ang goal niya, and in the future, saan niya balak gamitin ang talento? Kinilala nina Vice Ganda ang Dean's Lister at scholar na 'to! Si Charz naman, eksaherada ang 'sikip' ng "Tala" dance moves with backup dancers! Ang lakas ng 'amats' ng mga estudyante, gigil n'yo tuloy si Meme!

After all that fun, si Charz, ang nag-sample ng “Tala” prod, ang umabante sa jackpot round na para bang may swerteng hatid ang ‘masikip’ na dance moves niya. Umabot ng P30,000 ang Li-Pot offer, na sobra pa sa bayarin sa eskwela.

title: Itty P and DJ Model T's Dat's a RAP!
description: Two East Coast rappers come to Hollywood to be famous movie stars. This musical comedy chronicles this rap duo's raise to the top in this largely improvised season with original music and old school dance featuring the Sugah Pimps. From getting arrested to working for the man, Itty P and DJ Model T show the world just how to make it in LA.

title: Sir C. P.
description: Sir CP is a story about a fraud college owner who specializes in providing any degree, which is available in any university across the world, to his students. His work lands him in deep trouble and how he comes out of it forms the plot.

title: Vice ayaw pabalikin si Bong Bong sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
Limang ‘accla’ na maririkit ang nagpasiklaban ng wit sa isa na namang masayang weekly finals ng Miss Q and A sa "It's Showtime."

Bago ang talakan, enjoy muna ang mga Miss Q and A weekly finlists at ang mga hosts na sina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario sa kuwentuhan. Dahil Sabado at bihis na bihis ang mga 'fersons,' hindi maiwasan ang OOTD puksaan. Si Vice, napagtulungan dahil sa suot niyang shorts na basketball uniform daw, at boots na pampulis kalawakan. Si Jhong naman, very Gen Z at trendy sa buhok na kulot. Hirit naman ni Vice sa suot na nude vest ni Vhong, parang action star ang pormahan pero may Barbie arms.

Samantala, na-miss ni Vice Ganda ang pagkikita nila ni candidate Bong Bong, na lumaban noong August 13. Papayag nga ba si Meme na rumesbak si Bong Bong?

Idol talaga sa chukchakan sina Miss Q&A weekly finalists Jurexa Caparino, Nadimunyo Lustre, Miss Pau Ellarina Ortiz, Rocky Cueva, at CK Alcaraz Zarfl.

Si Nadimunyo ang unang naligwak sa kompetisyon, samantalang ang apat ay umabante sa Wit Lang. Mula naman sa apat, ang Top 2 na sina Rocky at CK ang nag-face off sa final round, Beklamation, kung saan pareho nilang hinarap ang tanong na, "Ano ang mas mahirap—tanggapin ang ayaw mo o tanggihan ang gusto mo?"

Mahusay sila sa time management habang pinagsasabay ang sports at academics. Pero sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, maging champion kaya ang mga student athletes?

Si player Angel-El, may pag-demo ng karate moves. Ingat lang baka matamaan ng sumisipa niyang galawan! Sumisipa rin ang good vibes sa aktingan round na You Gotta Lyric. Ito na ba 'yung DaCkie in an LQ scene? Ay, sina Ryan Bang at Teddy Corpuz pala!

Bigo ang mga natirang players na mka-survive hanggang dulo, kaya bumunot ng isang lucky manlalaro. Parang buzzer beater shot, biglang nabuhay ang kapalaran ni Jayvee. Hindi man niya nasagot ang POT question, hanga pa rin si Vice Ganda sa fighting spirit ni Jayvee at sa sipag ng mga kabataang atleta, kaya naisip niyang regaluhan ng extra P1,000 ang bawat players.

description: A boy determined to save his dad's failing private detective business enlists the help of his dog and parrot (who both talk) to take down the town's tyrannical tycoon, who wants to stop a mansion from being turned into an animal rescue.

description: Pip the penguin and Freddy the flamingo become the first non-stork employees for T.O.T.S (Tiny Ones Transport Service) who deliver babies to their parents.

title: P@St Forward
description: In 2022, 30-year-old Eliott, an ordinary salesman, writes to his first email address - from when he was ten - to check if it's still available. He's shocked when a reply comes from himself in 2001. As young Eliott listens to his older self's advice and crazy requests in regular emails, he starts to change the future for friends and family, as well as alter the course of his own destiny. Young Eliott tells his parents he's exchanging emails with his future self and gets sent to Dr Sax, a psychologist. Sax sees Eliott's incredible ability to predict the future (everything from 9/11 to new technology) as an endless source of power and money. When Eliott tries to escape his clutches, he finds himself pointing a gun at Sax - both in 2001 and 2022. But which Eliott kills him? Back in 2022, Eliott finally establishes a happy new reality, and everything appears settled. That is until he receives a phone call...from himself in 2042.

title: AJAA may perfect anthem para sa mga KINAKABAHAN kay crush
description:
Bumilis ang pintig ng puso ng kababaihan sa studio dahil sa pagdating ng mga gwapo. P-Pop group na AJAA, pinakilig ang mga tao, 'yung kilig na may halong kaba kapag si crush ay nasa tabi mo na. They performed their single "Kakabakaba," na perfect background music kapag nakikita ang taong nagpapabilis ng heartbeat mo.

Hindi pwedeng umatras ang mga beki na kinakabahan kapag oras na ng talakan. Panibagong linggo ng Miss Q and A, sinimulan nina Marjorie Lopez Buenaobra, Jov Prado, at Babyloves Monroe Solito.

Astig ang kandidatang si Marjorie na game mag-dance exhibition with buwis-buhay moves. Aray mo, bhie! Doble naman ang pressure na nilabanan ni Babyloves sa entablado dahil sumali na rin ang sa Miss Q and A ang boyfriend niya at umuwing panalo. Kaya biro ni Jhong Hilario, parang 'niraket' ng mag-bebe ang Miss Q and A. 

Sumakses si Marjorie sa unang round at sumalpak sa Wit Lang kung saan nabunot niya ang tanong na, "Bakit tuwalya ang laman ng goto, at hindi bimpo?" Naka-face off niya si Jov na naging witty rin as she 'talak-ed' sa nabunot na question, "Bakit magaan lang ang hibe?" 

Bumuhos ang emosyon sa Laro Laro Pick game arena sa mva kuwento ng katatagan at pagmamahal na ibinihagi ng Madlang Solo Parents mula NCR.

Bumilib ang Madlang People sa laki ng pagmamahal ni Danny sa mga anak, pati sa matibay nitong pananampalataya. Mahirap man daw ang buhay pero sisikapon ng biyudong si Danny na itaguyod ang pag-aaral ng mga anak.

Very beautiful naman ang smile ni Eve sa kabila ng madilim na pinagdaanan sa kamay ng dating asawa. Eh, kung ready na siya na muling buksan ang puso, si Ogie Alcasid may irereto.

Ang swerte ay kumapit kay player Nelle, na hindi rin napigilan ang luha nang ikuwento ang pinagdaanan bilang ina. Matapos umuwi mula Taiwan, kung saan sya nagtrabaho at nanganak, bigla na lang tumigil sa pagsusustento ang ama ng kanyang anak.

Naging praktikal si Nelle at tinanggap ang Li-Pot offer. Tama kaya ang kanyang desisyon?

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Kilig at good vibes ang hatid ng bisitang power couple na sina Jessa Zaragoza at Dingdong Avanzado sa kanilang performance, kasabay ng pagdiriwang nila ng kanilang 25th wedding anniversary. Parang ‘nainggit’ si Kim Chiu?

Akala n’yo tapos na, aba’y may comeback pang naghihintay. Ang tatlong reynang minsang natalo, muling lumaban nang sabay-sabay sa isa na namang round ng Miss Q and A Resbakulawan. Ang mga kinagiliwang kandidata na sina Mentoy Alexa Aang, Nicole Ayala Gokongwei, at Nadimunyo Lustre, muling tumalak para sa pagkakataon na tumatak at maiuwi ang korona.

Mula sa playtime questions, naging mas seryoso ang talakan sa Beklamation round kung saan sina Nadimunyo at Nicole ang nagharapan. Pareho nilang sinagot ang tanong na, “Sa panahon ngayon, sapat na ba ang pagsusumikap para umasenso?”

I-add ang tapang, i-multiply ang galing, tapos i-subtract ang kaba para mag-win. Mga future engineers ang bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Si Kim Chiu, biglang nahiya. Ay, si Jerald pala ang nakita! Mukhang effective ang lucky charm ni Jerald—kung si Kim man 'yon ang mga paru-paro sa buhok niya, dahil matapos ang pagsusulit, siya ang naging “topnotcher” ng batch at nakakuha ng slot sa jackpot round.

Para sa kanyang maraming pangangailangan sa eskwela at sa mga pangarap ng kanyang ama at ina, sinugalan ng University of the Philippines student ang ₱300,000 POT question at tinanggihan ang ₱40,000 Li-Pot offer. Hindi man niya nakuha ang tamang sagot, may magandang blessing na naghihintay kay Jerald dahil nangako si Vice Ganda na tutulungan siyang makabili ng bagong laptop para sa kanyang pag-aaral.

title: Kandidata, excited MALOTLOT sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
P-Pop rise! Nagdala ng fresh energy sa studio ang 12-member P-Pop group AZTER sa isang hataw at nakaka-LSS na performance ng kanilang kantang “Parang May Mali.”

Positive ang heart, pero dapat mabilis din ang isip dahil sa Miss Q and A, hindi sapat ang confidence at ganda kundi kailangan din ng wit. Nagpakitang-gilas sa talakan sina Tinderella Marie, C-Jay Ubias Tablit, at Serenity Winter.

Para bang na-manifest ni Tinderella ang sariling pagkalotlot dahil nagkatotoo ang sinabi niyang excited siyang “tumalot.” Siya nga ang unang naligwak matapos maunahan ng mga kalaban sa pindutan at sagutan sa Tumpak Ganern round.

Sina Serenity at C-Jay naman ang nag-face off sa Wit Lang, kung saan muling nasubok ang kanilang husay sa pagsagot sa playtime questions.

Umulan naman ng kilig at hiyawan sa studio sa pagpasok ng bagong duo na may hawak ng bowl of questions. Sina Brent Manalo at Ralph de Leon muna ang escorts for today. Para patunayan na deserve nila ang posisyon, daanin sa joke time ang audition.

Laging handa, ‘yan ang motto ng ating mga scout. Kaya sa pagsabak nila sa Laro Laro Pick, walang puwang ang doubt. Boy Scouts of the Philippines ang players for today's video. Ang swerte, sa kanila ba ay sasaludo?

Na-curious si Vice Ganda nang makita ang mga girl sa hanay ng players na bahagi ng Boy Scouts of the Philippines. Sa jackpot round, si Yel ang umabante para sa chance na maiuwi ang P200,000 POT money. Naibigay kaya ni Yel ang tamang sagot at naiuwi ang malaking POT money?

title: Miss Q&A: Barbie Bratz
description:
Kung may sariling opinyon, 'yan ay karapatan! Basta't may respeto pa rin, huwag matatakot ipahayag ang paninindigan. Nagbabalik ang limang Miss Q and A 'ResBAKS' na sa talakan ay walang inuurungan, sa weekly finals ng Resbakulawan round.

Pare-parehong 'nalotlot' sa unang sabak sa pagtalak, but now they're back stronger and fiercer, still with a dash of laughter. From the daily Resbakulawan, oras na para sa final face-off nina Barbie Bratz Ayuda, Andrea Jane Peralta, Misis Jawo, Miss Mia, at Carla Flores Argonza sa “It’s Showtime” July 25 episode.

Hindi maiwasan ang lutang moments sa unang round. May nabibingi sa tanong, at merong hula-hula lang ang sagot. Si Andrea ang unang naligwak sa laban. Pero bumawi ang candidates sa Wit Lang round.

Pagkatapos ng Wit Lang, sina Barbie Bratz at Carla ang umangat at nagharap sa Beklamation, kung saan pareho silang palaban sa katanungan na, "Ano ang mas gusto mo, maging pride o joy ka ng magulang mo?" Naghatid nga ng pride at joy sa kanyang mga magulang si Carla dahil siya ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Resbakulawan weekly winner.

Ika'y mapapangiti sa ganda ni Bianca Umali, na guest co-host nina Vice Ganda at Amy Perez sa Laro Laro Pick, July 25 episode ng “It’s Showtime,” kung saan bumida ang mga taga-Don Bosco, Paranaque.

Si Joan ay tumama kaya siya ang umabante sa jackpot round for the chance to win P100,000. Matapang na sinugalan ni Joan ang POT question, ngunit bigo siyang maibigay ang tamang sagot.

Sa dulo ng programa, naglabas ng isang statement si Vice Ganda. Aniya, nakarating sa pamunuan ng "It's Showttime" ang mga komento ng viewers at netizens na na-offend o hindi nagustuhan ang ilang jokes ng hosts, partikular na sa 'Memerimar' episodes sa Laro Laro Pick kaya naman humingi ng dispensa si Vice.

title: Miss Q&A Amara
description:
Maaga ang Pasko feels kasama ang paboritong ‘inaanak’ ng Madlang People at “It’s Showtime” family, ang super talented na si Imogen Cantong. Pero si Imogen ang may handong na aguinaldo—isang sweet na awitin, her new single titled “Para sa Aming Bukas.”

Huwag matakot tumalak and let your voice be heard, katulad ng mga kandidata na hindi susuko hanggang sa makamit ang inaasam na korona.

Meet Amara Nicole Delos Santos, Trixie Gomez, Christian Basmayor Bataller. Salpukan ng wit ay nagtuloy-tuloy sa Wit Lang round. Kung akayo si Christian, paano niya sasagutin ang tanong na, "Anong pakiramdam ng mais na hinahanap-hanap siya sa corned beef?" At, masaya ba ang repolyo kapag tinutusok siya ng hotdog?" naman ang tanong na nabunot ni Trixie.

Ngayong Martes, sino ang ‘yong nami-miss? Ayiieee! Ang tamis! Enjoy the feels, pero make sure na hindi mo mami-miss ang kulitan sa Laro Laro Pick kung saan bumida ang mga taga-Bagumbayan, Taguig sa game arena.

Sa Act-Song, si Vhong Navarro umeksena kina Darren Espanto at Cianne Dominguez. Si Ryan Bang naman, “binasted” si Cianne? Sa dulo ng laro, si Mckoy ang panalo at umabante sa jackpot round.

Sa dulo ng laro, si Mckoy ang panalo at umabante sa jackpot round. Ang raketbniya, magbenta ng matatamis na pastries. Matamis din kaya ang maging kapalaran niya at maiuwi ang POT money?

title: WALANG WINNER TODAY sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
Sa pamamagitan ng kanyang awitin, ginamit ni TNT champ JM Yosures ang boses para imulat ang mata ng mga Pilipino, na lahat tayo ay may kontribusyon upang labanan ang kahirapan.

Dahil brand new ang week, may fresh batch of "Miss Q and A" candidates na nag-hello sa "It's Showtime."Ganap na ganap sa puksaan at talakan sina Binibining Dana, Jinger Aman Villamor, at Wynzhl Bansagan.

Pagkatapos ng Tumpak Ganern round, sina Jinger at Binibining Dana ang nakalusot, samantalang si Wynzhl ay umuwing lotlot" Anong mas ayaw mo kapag matutulog, ‘yung may maingay na aso o may katabi na amoy aso?" ang tanong na nabunot ni Jinger. Sakto because she's a loving fur mom! Pero mukhang hindi sumakto ang sagot niya kina hurados Bianca Umali, Ralph de Leon, at Nicole Cordoves. Gano'n din ang komento nila sa sagot ni Binibining Dana, na tumalak tungkol sa mga bestie na snaky.

Biro ni Vice Ganda, parang walang winner today. Pero maya-maya pa ay kinoronahan ang totoong reyna. Sa araw na 'to, si Jinger ang itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era.

Samantala, ginamit din ni Brent Manalo ang boses para 'tumalak' sa ipapatayong AI and semiconductor industrial hub, Pax Silica, sa kanyang hometown sa Tarlac. At sa pagbabalik ni Darren, naipit si Jackie Gonzaga, na sa sobrang haba ng hair ay balik-love triangle with Darren at Brent.

Sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, nagpahinga muna ang mga players na masahista. Minalas no'ng una pero bumawi ang swerte kay player Budang, na nabunot para sa jackpot round. No'ng una ay ipinaglaban niya ang POT para sa inang may cancer, at kapatid na may sakit sa puso. Pero, minsan panalo na rin ang sigurado, kaya sa dulo, forda Li-Pot na si Budang sa halagang P30,000. Sinunod niya si nanay.

title: Miss Q&A Nunoy
description:
Maligayawang kaarawan, Chief of OPM Ogie Alcasid. Bukod sa "It's Showtime" family, present to celebrate ang nag-iisang reyna sa puso niya, his forever favorite ka-duet, his misis Regine Velasquez. From the heart ang mensahe ni Asia's Songbird sa chief ng kanilang tahanan.

Imbitado rin sa episode ang isa pang hitmaker, Moira dela Torre, na ginulat ang malang people sa mataas niyang energy.

Hit at bentang-benta rin ang witty talak ng tatlong kandidata sa Miss Q and A. Break muna sa pagbubbunot ng ngipin ang dentistang si Dra. Ruth Qanal, at sa chukchakan muna siya humugot ng banat. Ima-mine mo rin ang good vibe na dala ni Dyeyzel Romero, ang live seller talakera. At agaw-eksena ang intro ni Nunoy, na para bang dinala tayo sa liga ng basketball.

Triple treat din ang attendance nina Anne Curtis, Vice Ganda, at Vhong Navarro, na hindi matapos-tapos ang kulitan at bardagulan. Anne is back, and so is her 'bulol' hosting, kaya si Meme Vice ay 'nabuwisit' sa kanyang sabaw moments.

Pati ang hosts nag-enjoy sa mga tanong sa Tumpak Ganern. Ano nga ba sa Ingles ang tanikala? At ang isang bugtong, nasagot ni Anne, but as usual, in a sosyal way nga lang!

Nag-babu nang maaga si doktora, matapos maligwak sa Tumpak Ganern round. Kaya sina Dyeyzel at Nunoy ang umabante sa Wit Lang.

From palengke, napasugod sa game arena ang mga masisipag na tindero't tindera. Pasok, mga suki, swerte ay hitik sa Laro Laro Pick.

Usapang isda muna tayo kasama si nanay Dada, na nag-sample kung paano mag-alok sa mga parokyano at pumaldo nang todo. Ang isa pang sikreto, dapat kilay on fleek upang ang customers ay maakit.

Gulay na madaling itanim at anihin naman ang category sa It's Giving kung saan dalawa lang ang natira. It's Dada versus Mila. Pagdatating sa hulaan ng title ng kanta, parehong olats ang dalawa. Kaya bumunot ng iba, at ang swerte ay kay Mie napunta.

P450,000 ang pwede niyang mapanalunan. Syemmpre, gusto ni Mie 'yan! Pero mas pinili niyang maging praktikal at tanggapin ang Li-Pat offer na P50,000. 'Yun nga lang, alam pala ni Mie ang sagot sa katanungan.
