title: Mga beki, walang takot na tumalak sa MIss Q&A weekly finals
description:
Peek-a-boo! Good vibes sa "It's Showtime" ay boo-hay na boo-hay! Dito, walang katatakutan, puro lang kulitan. Spook-tacular ang happiness na dala para sa Madlang People and everyone.

Ang birthday girl na si Jackie Gonzaga, mothering sa syawan kasama ang Miss Q and A queens of the week. At hindi na mumultuhin pa ang DaCkie at BreCkie shippers, dahil sina Darren Espanto at Brent Manalo nagbigay ng mensaheng galing sa puso.

Who run the world? Mga 'accla' na sa talakan ay pang-Miss Universe ang level. Sumabak sa Miss Q and A weekly finals sina Yoniel Torayno Acebuche, Gigi Esguerra, Leoki Inokuma Ganacias, Ralph Conducto Romero, at Yan Evangelista.

Si Leoki ang unang naligwak at umuwing lotlot, samantalang ang apat na tumama sa Tumpak Ganern round ay umabante sa Wit Lang kung saan laroshi na naman ang questions, kaya si Vice Ganda, tawang-tawa!

Ang Top 2 na sina Ralph at Yoniel ang nagpuksaan sa Beklamation. From playtime, naging serious ang question, "Anong pwede mong ikatakot bago ka mamatay?"

Walang zombie na maghahasik ng lagim. Pero may pa-Zumba kaya siguradong mapapsayaw ka rin kasama ang mga ZUmba instructors na bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Dagdag smiles ang hatid ni Alora Sasam, na first time ma-cast sa aktingan portion na You Gotta Lyric. Feel na feel din ni Jhong HIlario ang energy, kaya naging instant Zumba instructor ang Sample King! Ang saya ng sayawan sa studio!

Katulad ng moves niyang solid, hindi natinag ang fighting spirit ni Jaja sa jackPOT round kung saan buong tapang niyang sinugalan ang ₱250,000 POT question at nag-goodbye sa Li-POT offer.

title: Miss Q&A Johanna, huling-huli ang PIKA ni Vice Ganda
description:
Tuloy-tuloy ang throwback feels sa pagsasama ng special guests na The Company at Neocolours, na bumuhay sa tanghalian ng Madlang People with their timeless OPM classics.

Bago ipaabot kay Santa Claus ang mga wish, ang mga kandidata sa Miss Q and A, rumampa nang fierce. I-unwrap ang kanilang mga talak! Meet James O’Briant, Anja Isler Velazco, at Johanna Carla Alcantara Garcia.

Fashion designer si James na nagbibihis ng mga artista, and now she's back with a vengeance matapos 'malotlot' noong Season 2. Si Anja naman ay isang digital marketing specialist na minsang gumawa ng thesis tungkol kay Vice Ganda.

Fresh from her recent birthday celebration naman si Johanna. Pero walang birthday privilege sa Miss Q and A. Biro ni Meme, hindi ito sumunod sa instructions matapos magbigay ng dalawa, sa halip na tatlong 'I believe' statements. Kaya naman huling-huli ni Johanna ang pika ni Vice Ganda!

Si Johanna ang unang umabante sa Wit Lang, at sumunod naman si James. Tinanong si Johanna kung ano sa tingin niya ang nararamdaman ng medyas na laging nawawala ang partner nito. Nabunot naman ni James ang tanong na, "Sa palagay mo, ano ang nararamdaman ng takure na lagi siyang pinag-iinitan?"

Mula Putatan, Muntinlupa, dala nila’y saya dahil ang premyo rito sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ay hindi 'munti' ang halaga. Kapag sinamahan ng diskarte ang paglalaro, P100,000 and POT money ang maiuuwi.

Good vibes ang kuwentuhan with player Palakpak. Kung nagtataka kayo sa alamat ng kanyang pangalan, the answer is nagmula 'yan sa pag-aalaga niya ng mga kalapati.

Si player Len ang only survivor sa Act-Song round. Ssingle man, hindi naman malungkot si Len dahil sa masayang karanasan sa game arena kahit pa dumaplis lang sa mga kamay niya ang ₱100,000 POT money.

title: Miss Q&A Martie, gustong mag-back out?
description:
Sagot na ni JM Dela Cerna ang pangmalakasang harana. Parang hugis 'otso,' to infinity and beyond ang husay ni JM sa entablado. Pati 'What's up, Madlang People' ibinirit nang todo.

Great ang performance ng tatlong beki na nagtalakan sa Miss Q and A, na sina Ral Imperial ng Batangas, Carla Flores Argonza ng Pangasinan, at Martie Anne Panlilio ng Tarlac.

Hindi 'puchu-puchu' ang tatlong ito, na pare-parehong may napatunayan na sa kanilang pag-aaral. Si Ral ay may dalawang Latin honors, si Carla naman ay may double degree, at si Martie ay scholar.

Na-earn nina Ral at Carla ang respeto ng mga hurado sa talak nilang galing sa puso at pinag-isipan during the Wit Lang round. Nabunot ni Ral ang tanong na, "Sa iyong palagay, saan mas hirap si Rapunzel, mag-blower o mag-shampoo?" Kalmado rin ang pagsagot ni Carla sa tanong na, "Kung huling hininga mo na, anong mas gusto mo, pa-inhale o pa-exhale?"

Markado ang sagot ni Carla kina hurados Ralph de Leon, Nicole Cordoves, at Esnyr na nagbihis bilang Ms. Castro, isa sa mga karakter sa kanyang online series.

Sa Laro Laro Pick, lahat ay swerte, walang malas. Kaya positive vibes lang ang dala ng mga taga-Navotas. Ang laro, nauwi sa concert nang maka-face off ni player Diane si Baby Doll Johaira sa sayawan at kantahan.

Naubos ang players sa It's Giving round kaya bumunot ng dalawang sasabak sa You Gotta Lyric, at ito ay sina Roland at Dindin. Lahat ay lucky pero si Dindin ang may pinakabonggang swerte.

Si Dindin, isang mananahi na solo parent, maingat na pumili. Kung ang kasamang anak ay forda experience ang gusto, si Nanay Dindin, mas gustong maging sigurado at tinanggap ang P40,000 Li-Pot offer.

title: Linda Walker natameme sa sagot ni Kelly sa Miss Q&A It's Showtime
description:
Loud ang cheers at concert feels sa June 16 episode ng "It's Showtime," as Ryan Bang performed some of the best OPM hits sa isang masayang birthdayprod, na nagpaindak sa mga manonood.

Araw-araw ay parang grand celebration ng mga 'beki' na hatid ay good vibes. Sa Day 2 ng pinakabagong season ng "Miss Q and A," muling umulan ng tawanan kasama ang sangkabaklaan.

Nagpasiklaban sina Contestant 1 Michelle Calamity, Contestant 2 Kelly Agustin, at Contestant 3 Linda Walker. Kung si Vice Ganda ang kahulma ni Michelle, si Jhong Hilario naman daw ang kamukha ni Contestant 2. At kung fairytale ang kuwento for today’s video, si Kelly ang prinsesang napapaligiran ng wicked stepsisters.

Sa unang round, ligwak si Contestant 1, pero pangako niya, she will return better and fiercer than ever. Sa pabonggahan naman ng wit sa ikalawang round, full of confidence ang pagsagot ni Linda, at pak na pak ang opinyon ni Kelly. Proving that she's got both beauty and brains, nasungkit ni Kelly ang bilib ng judges na sina Karylle, Ralph de Leon at Nicole Cordoves. Si Kelly ang itinanghal na Reyna Talak-Era of the day!

Palaki nang palaki ang papremyo sa game arena, kaya naman ganado sa Laro Laro Pick ang mga senior citizens ng Tandang Sora.

Agaw-eksena ang rakistang si Bro, na um-skip muna sa isang mahalagang pag-uwi sa probinsya para makapaglaro sa studio. Si Vice Ganda naman ang maintenance nina Lola Nene at Edith dahil makita lang siya, sapat na para sumaya!

Dahil ginalingan at kinapitan ang swerte, sa jackpot round, si Tatay Roger ang umabante. Pagpapataya ng 'ending' ang kanyang pinagkakakitaan. Katulad ng hanapbuhay ni tatay, kailangan sumugal para makuha ang jackpot money na P200,000.

Siguradong may isang lolo na happy dahil si tatay Roger ay may maiuuwing P30k, matapos tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer.

title: Miss Q&A Patty, binalikan ang pagsali noon sa TNT
description:
Sakto ang chillax vibe na hatid nina Jarea at Jeremy G sa kanilang kantang “Kanlungan.” At may payo rin sila para sa mga listeners na hanggang ngayon ay naghahanap pa rin ng taong matatawag nilang pahinga at tahanan.

Sa Miss Q&A, talino at wit ang tunay na puhunan kaya bawat sagot dapat may dtaing at laman. Hindi sapat ang ganda kung kulang naman sa banat. Dahil sa pageant na 'to, pagalingan ng talak!

Walang preno sa pag-chukchak sina Patty Yum, Seika Mitch Fernando, at Cheesecake Sterling. Sa kanilang tatlo, sino ang pinakamagaling?

Nagkainitan agad ang mga kandidata nang nang hindi maniwala si Seika na maganda si Patty, na minsan na palang sumali sa TNT. Sino nga ba sa tatlo ang may backer? Teka, idaan na lang ang kulitan sa aktingan na full of laughter, with Jhong Hilario stepping in as the Prince Charming.

Sa Wit Lang round, sina Seika at Cheesecake ang nagharap sa playtime na sagutan. Natanong si Seika kung magseselos ba siya kapag ang tawag ng nanay niya sa daga ay “mabait” pero sa kanya ay “animal,” habang si Cheesecake naman ay nabunot ang tanong na, Kung flat-chested ka, didibdibin mo ba ang kalagayan mo?”

Sa Laro Laro Pick ng "It's Showtime," nursing students mula NCR ang ating nakasama. Magaling silang mag-alaga ng pasyente, kaya for sure, ang puso n'yo ay mapapatibok nila.

Napansin agad ni Vice Ganda ang charm ni player Ella, sabay ipinantapat ang equally cute na 'naka-naka' niyang si Ryan, na kapag nag-flex ng chinito smile, ay, kikiligin ka talaga dhai!

Samantala, back to the game, pati sina Julia Barretto at Joshua Garcia, naki-join sa aktingan. Si nursing student Jess naman ang umabante sa jackpot round. Mapapataas kaya niya ang “vital signs” ng swerte para maiuwi niya ang P300,000 POT money?

title: Miss Q&A candidate, napagkamalang QUEZO DE BOLA | It's Showtime | November 11
description:
Fly, fly, fly like a butterfly at i-enjoy ang buhay. Pero kung ikaw magiging paru-paro, siguro sa bahay ni crush ka dadapo, ano?

Pero ngayong araw, kilig naman ang dumapo sa ating puso, dahil sa matatamis na harana nina Tawag Ng Tanghalan champions JM Yosures, Reiven Umali, Christian Tibayan, Yannie Basical, at JM Dela Cerna na ang mga boses ay talaga namang nakakawala ng pagod at problema.

Dito ang tingin! Mga paru-paro ng sangkabaklaan, lumipad nang malaya sa Resbakulawan. Sa "Miss Q and A" segment sa November 11 episode ng "It's Showtime,” nagrampasiklaban sina Hera Sanchez Santivaniez, Reign Manzano Gaboy, at Jeraldine Brittany Hawthorne for the chance to comeback sa entablado ng mga beking pakak kung chumukchak!

Kapag kumpleto ang tropa, mas masarap ang kwentuhan lalo na kung puro kalokohan ang laman ng usapan. It's another round of bardagulan with Vice Ganda, Anne Curtis, Vhong Navarro at Jhong Hilario. From love and organic encounter to trending hits, ang Showtime Quadro ‘di mauubusan ng topic.

'Di rin nagpaawat sa pagtalak ang mga ResBAKS. Sa unang round, isa-isa silang sumabak sa Wit Lang. Ang Top 2 na sina Jeraldine at Hera ang umabante sa Beklamation.

Samalamig! Samalamig! Sino'ng gustong magpalamig? Mula sa Malamig, Mandaluyong ang mga bisitang dumating sa Laro Laro Piick game arena. Pero ang mga challenges dito, mainit! Dahil P100,000 POT money ang gustong makamit!

Si player Lee, pinainit ang dance floor sa kanyang moves ala Baby Dolls, na para bang nag-o-audition sa harap ni Vice Ganda. At ano itong gustong i-donate ni Lee kay Ogie Alcasid?

Ang tubong-Malamig na si Lean, cool na cool lang ang datingan kaya mabilis na umabante sa jackpot round!

title: Miss Q&A: Thalia, na-STEAL ang pwesto kay Julia
description:
Maki-sound trip na with with the musical duo Music Travel Love, na binubuo ng magkaatid na Bob and Clint Moffatt, na mula sa pop-rock band The Moffatts, ang mga OG crushies ng '90s girlies. Times three ang kilig dahil kasama pa ang kanilang triplet brother na si Dave.

Signal No.5 ang pagbuhos ng wit ng mga "Miss Q and A" candidates. Sa June 25 episode, sina Julia Masungsong, Thalia Marimar Fulgoso Meiy Amor, at Mama Mama ang best in recitation, talak kung talak for the whole nation. Kapag nagkandabuhol-buhol ang sagot, idaan na lang sa conviction!

Si Mama Mama, mabilis na nakalusot sa 'Tumpak Ganern' round matapos maibigay ang tamang English term ng 'hikab.' Pero nagkagulo ang everyone sa ikalawang katanungan na may kinalaman sa spelling!

Nilaban ni Julia ang sagot niya sa spelling ng “vaccum” na “victory-a-c-u-u-m” pero hindi ito tinanggap dahil, paliwanag ni Vice Ganda, hindi letra ang “victory.”

Sa 'Wit Lang' round, nabunot ni Mama Mama ang tanong na kung ano ang gagawin niya kapag nanaginip siya na kumakain siya ng masarap pero paggising ay may waiter na naniningil. Si Thalia naman, bahagyang natigilan sa kalagitnaan ng talak, pero effective naman na pambawi ang kanyang cute na ngiti.

Samantala, expect heavy downpour ng kagandahan sa pagdating ng espesyal na hurado, si Miss Universe 2025 3rd runner-up Ahtisa Manalo. Thunderstorm advisory: Posibleng bumuhos ang selos! Si Vice Ganda, para bang 'na-jelly' sa pagpansin ni Ahtisa sa joke ng kanyang hubby. Hayaan mo na, Meme! Tumawa lang naman, eh!

Inspirasyon na dala ng mga AUsome parents na bumida sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena. Sila ang mga mapagmahal at matatatag na magulang na may anak na PWD (Person With Disability). Hinangaan ng Madlang People ang tibay ng puso ni Nanay Lele, na ang anak ay bulag at may autism. Doble pa ang hirap ni nanay dahil solo lang siya sa buhay, at walang sustentong nakukuha sa dating asawa. Pero doble rin ang pagmamahal na ibinubuhos sa anak niya.

Kahit nagbabadya ang buhos ng ulan sa kalangitan, hindi suspended ang pagpapalabas ng 'Showtime The Movie,' este ng mga eksena sa 'You Gotta Lyric.' With special participation ni

Ralph de Leon ang breakup scene kung saan ang kagandahan ni Lassy, mas lumamang sa alindog ni Cianne.

All-star cast naman ang mala-"Princess Sara" na eksena kung saan bumida si Vice Ganda. Siya si Vice Sara! At ang leading man ni Meme, syempre, si Ion Perez bilang Peter C. Walang nakaligtas sa lupit ni Jhong Hilario bilang Miss Minchin, na pabirong pinag-trip-an si Meme at ginawang 'fur baby.' Hanggang sa ang eksenang pagtatanan, nauwi sa habulan (nadapa si Miss Minchin!) at basaan! Walang Unkabogable card dito, dahil kahit si Vice Ganda, ayun, basang-basa!

Pagkatapos ng magulong aktingan, naging seryoso ang usapan nina Vice at Lele sa jackpot round. Si Meme, nagbigay ng payo sa mga nagpaplanong magkaroon ng anak. Mabilisan na ang tawaran, si Meme na mismo ang nanghikayat kay Nanay Lele na mag-POT.

Dahan-dahang binasa ni Meme ang POT question, na nasagot ni Nanay Lele nang tama kaya sa kanya ang P100,000 jackpot money! Bumuhos ang luha ni Nanay Lele at napayakap kay Meme.

title: Ziggy: Soreyuke! R&R Band
description: Japanese rock band Ziggy comes to London and gets attacked upon arrival at the hotel after a recording session. title: After We're Over
description: One fateful Saturday, Zelzah (Adrienne Rose White) receives a call out of the blue from her ex, Sazerac (Chris Mollica). It's the first she's heard from him in the year since he broke her heart and left St. Louis to move home to Long Island. Wearily, Zelzah decides to grab breakfast with him, which turns into a day-long exploration of the city of St. Louis - and their failed relationship. Over the course of the day, the film slips in time. As the two come together in the present, we see them fall apart in the past, their memories bleeding into their current conversations. While visiting some of the city's most famous landmarks, they discuss love, death, sex, politics, memory, and what we owe to each other and ourselves, as well as the ultimate question: can they begin again after they're over?

title: You're Fired
description: Railroad magnate Gordon Rogers agrees to allow his daughter, Helen, to marry wealthy idler Billy Deering, Jr., but only if the latter can hold the same job for one month. Billy is hired for an array of jobs, including office clerk and xylophone player, but always quits just before being fired. He then finds work in a restaurant where he is required to dress as a knight in armor and pose as a statue. On one occasion, Gordon, Helen, and Billy's romantic rival, Tom, enter the restaurant, and Billy is nearly fired when Helen recognizes him. Meanwhile, Gordon plans to merge one of his railroads with a company that is in a dispute with Tom's uncle, an unprincipled financier. Acting on the promise of a generous cash reward, Tom is determined to steal documents relating to the merger. Billy manages to stay at his job for thirty days, and in the process, exposes Tom's scheme, winning Gordon's consent to marry Helen.

The soldier lives in a so-called limbo of a future society where the one and the only law which is observed is "homo homini lupus"; he plays his personal chess game in a constant balance between the physical violence and the psychological torture, in a delirious climax whose highest point is an external act of becoming conscious of the situation. How long can a man resist under torture? How far can a man push his limits? But, above all, who is the mole?

title: S.O.N.S. (Sons of Nanay Sabel)
description: S.O.N.S. (Sons of Nanay Sabel)

title: Sluchay s patsanom
description: Yura - a guy from the workers' quarter far from politics - by the will of fate finds himself drawn into the maelstrom of political events.

title: Dívka s muslí
description: Thirteen-year-old Vendula (Dita Kaplanová) dozes off at school and dreams about her parents riding in a carriage dressed in their wedding clothes. The young teacher is angry with the girl who has already failed a year, and has no idea that she is looking after three younger half-brothers. They all have a different father and their mother (Evelyna Steimarová) comes home noisy and drunk every day, often accompanied by a man. Early in the morning, Vendula helps her mother clean offices, and sometimes has to do the cleaning all by herself. Her eldest brother Libor is good at school and blindly adores his mother. Jeník is a talented flute player and much more cynical. The youngest Venousek is still a toddler. The only one who is cared of is Vendula by her father (Ladislav Frej), who has divorced his confirmed alcoholic wife years ago and has another daughter in his new family. All his attempts to persuade Vendula to move in with them are in vain. The girl is selflessly trying to keep the family together.

title: Munnabhai S.S.C.
description: Munnbhai (Amit) has been repeating in SSC frequently.He is good at heart and sports but mischievous.Fed up with his daily tantrums his father throws him out of the house.

title: My s dedushkoy
description: A city boy (Timofey Razuvaev) is sent to live with his grandpa in the countryside. Through quarrels, misunderstandings and the grandfather's brush with death, the two eventually forge an unbreakable bond of affection.

title: Roman s kokainom
description: The plot of one of the brightest, mysterious and extraordinary works of the 30th years of the last century "The novel with cocaine" (the author M. Levi, a pseudonym M. Ageev) which has gained really world recognition is the basis for the script of the movie. Between heroes of the novel and movie almost century whether and a lot of things have changed during this time in human essence? This movie how shouldn't be. But from century to century repeats.

title: S.O.S Mamis 2: Mosquita Muerta
description: Daniela is the new mother at Saint Michael School. Trini feels that there is something wrong with Daniela, she will discover her big secret, showing the true nature of Daniela.

title: Tí@s
description: Inspired by the discrimination suffered by his uncle Ramón because of his sexual condition, John Petrizzelli uses the screen to narrate the life of different people who have something in common: sexual-diversity. The stories feature from the anecdotal to the transcendental, looking for the intimate world of old age without losing sight of the life of each character with different ways of looking at aging, loneliness and death.

title: Project S
description: A search for the power of good design and the influence of an object on the heart.

title: Allegro s ognyom
description: In June 1941, the fascists tried to block the Black Sea Fleet in Sevastopol, throwing new top-secret magnetic-acoustic mines into the channel. To neutralize this formidable weapon, a special group of volunteers was created.

title: Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. S1-S2
description: The Incredible Hulk teams up with Red Hulk, She-Hulk, Skaar, and Rick Jones aka A-Bomb to battle the forces of evil in front of cameras for Rick's web-based series to show the Hulk is more hero than monster.

title: Mír s tuleni
description: Framed by two stories, this feature documentary fable PEACE WITH SEALS deals with the concept of "human nature". The first story is about a seal named Gaston who, according to the Prague Zoo director, became "the most famous animal on earth" after he managed to reach Germany during a devastating flood. At the height of his fame, Gaston was adopted by the former Prime Minister Gross; after Gaston's death, the Prague Zoo erected a statue in his memory. The second story took place 50 years earlier and tells the life story of a seal named Ulysses, caught in Sardinia by a Milan photojournalist who, in front of the cameras, tossed the animal into the famous Di Trevi fountain. Patellani - a friend of Federico Fellini's and a specialist on film stars - was fined for his action. The reason, however, was not the killing of a baby seal but the pollution of water in the fountain. Fellini took inspiration from the story for "La Dolce Vita"; referring to photojournalists such as Patellani, he coined the term "paparazzi", i.e. those who create the "nature" of contemporary man. What changes mark our relationship with animals? Today there are urban nature reserves, aquariums instead of oceans, and seal hunting can be booked with a travel agent. In the time of Homer, seals were the most widespread inhabitant of Europe's largest biotope, the Mediterranean Sea. Today, with sun tanning being so fashionable, people have replaced the seals on the beaches. Seals have become one of the most endangered mammals in Europe. Where will we be able to encounter wild animals in the future? How are animals being domesticated? And what is the domestication of people?

title: Tod@s caen
description: Adán (Omar Chaparro) is a charming seducer who believes he knows how to make any woman swoon. He prepares to teach his friends the art of conquering women, using his array of bullet-proof rules of seduction. Mia (Martha Higareda) is an ambitious producer who dreams of having her own TV show on women empowerment called "Todos Caen," a strategic guide to dating that teaches you just how to hook a man--and have him eating out of your hand in no time. Mia and Adán cross paths at a bar one fateful night, and from there the game is on in an all-out battle of the sexes. But as they test their finely-honed seduction strategies on each other, both find that sometimes the more you play hard to get, the harder you may end up falling.

title: Free Money
description: When universal basic income (UBI) comes to the Kenyan village of Kogutu, lives are forever changed. GiveDirectly, one of the fastest growing nonprofits of the 21st century, is sending free money for twelve years as part of the world's largest UBI experiment. Filmmakers Lauren DeFilippo and Sam Soko juxtapose the story of these young economists, bankrolled by Silicon Valley and convinced that they have found an infallible algorithm to end world poverty, with portraits of local Kenyans whose lives are being dramatically impacted for better and for worse. UBI is at the forefront of political debate like never before, thanks to Andrew Yang's presidential candidacy, covid stimulus packages, and trials underway around the world. This documentary is a fascinating case study of life in a village-turned-petri-dish from the perspective of those living out this revolutionary idea.

title: Vjeruj u ljubav
description: "Vjeruj u ljubav" was licensed reality show broadcasted on Croatian RTL television hosted by actor Danijel Ljuboja. The purpose of the show was to connect various people and give them opportunity to start or continue their once broken relationship. The show was not limited only to people who developed romantic feelings toward someone else but also included long lost friends, relatives and similar. People who were seeking contact usually would record video message for that special someone. The wanted person would watch the message and decide is she/he willing to establish the connection. The whole procedure was filmed and edited into feature stories as part of the episode. Each episode was consisted of studio part where people would finally meet and edited stories which explained the background of relations presented in the show.

title: I Luv U But
description: What would you sacrifice for your family? Sam and Mouna are both gay and can never come out to their parents, so they married for convenience. They are living a lie but they are living it up! They are 'out' to their closest friends, but still in the closet when it comes to their family and the big Leb community. Secret lives filled with love and despair. Why would anyone live like that? These couples are all Australian by birth, but Lebanese for life. This is about culture, family and honour. They can never 'come out' to their family as the family would never accept it, they would be ostrasized and who knows what else! Sam and Mouna, like so many Arabs around the world, just don't come out - and they do whatever it takes to keep their sexuality a secret. This series shows one story among many of Arab queers living this life.

title: V síti 18+
description: Movie about grooming and abusing young girls by adult men online. Three young looking adult actresses have been given the roles of three 12 years old girls, who's role was to run the fake social media accounts in fake, but realistically looking bedrooms under the full observation of professional team of filmmakers, psychologists, lawyer, to show how easy it is for an adult man to contact young underage girls online without any knowledge of their parents. It shows what tactics the groomers use to gain very personal information and photos from the girls and what inappropriate graphical content groomers share with them.

title: Murder in Polná
description: An exciting drama from a detective history. In 1899 a dead girl - seamstress Anezka Hruzová - was found between the village of Veznicka and the town of Polná. She was 19 and she had a cutting wound on the throat. There was no sexual violence involved and since the local doctors thought that there was not enough blood on the crime scene, everyone jumped to the conclusion that Jews must have killed her and added her blood to their pass-over matzot. There was a potential murderer at hand too - a cheeky, not very bright young Jewish rover, Leopold Hilsner...

title: The Care They've Earned
description: It is a gripping look into six proud veterans' experiences with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) as they seek to manage the mental and physical trauma they sustained in uniform. The documentary details their experiences with an embattled VA - from botched surgeries to misdiagnoses to personnel shortfalls - and educates about the fundamental changes and reforms that are needed to ensure our veterans are taken care of in a way that honors their service. It asks viewers to reflect on serious and complex questions about what kind of care our veterans have earned after they hang up their uniforms and when, how, and where they receive that care. The Care They've Earned tells the stories of six veterans, but it highlights the struggles of finding adequate health care that all veterans face. It educates about the opportunity that more choices could mean for our veterans to receive the care they need - when and where they need it.

title: Tariq w Nouf
description: It follows the diaries of Tariq and Nouf, who are exposed to many daily situations and mishaps in their lives, and they attempt to confront them.

title: W Msheet
description: A lady named Meida comes back from Canada to Lebanon with her daughter Talia after 16 years of leaving the country.

title: Haya W Banatha
description: In an attempt to cover up a scandal, Haya's family forces her to wed an elderly man. As the years pass, her husband's death forces Haya to shoulder the responsibility of caring for her daughters as she tries to put the past to rest.

title: Dzien, w którym znalazlem w smieciach dziewczyne
description: In the near future, the indifferent activist announces that he will commit suicide at midnight on New Year's Eve in protest against the reigning slavery in Poland. His plan is questioned when he finds an abandoned slave girl in the garbage and decides to help her regain her freedom.

title: W domu
description: Spring 2020, Poland. 16 filmmakers create 14 short films about unexpected experience of isolation caused by pandemic.

title: W. Somerset Maugham
description: An anthology series based on the varied stories by W. Somerset Maugham divided into three categories: "Rule Britannia" about colonial life, "Women of the World" which focus on female characters, and "Victims of Fate".

title: Shamshoun & Dalila
description: In a blend of comedy, suspense, and action, Shamshon is forced to steal a legendary diamond to rescue his kidnapped sister, while Dalilah is mysteriously tasked with stealing it for herself. Their missions intersect in a chase filled with tricks, pranks, and clever confrontations, transforming their seemingly disparate paths into an unexpected love story. Ultimately, they are forced to join forces with an international alliance to determine who is the best and to seize the diamond at any cost.

title: F.T.W.
description: Frank T. Wells has just been released from prison after serving a term for manslaughter. Frank's a reasonably honest man and a good rodeo rider. When he meets up with Scarlett, a bank robber on the run, his whole life changes.

title: Kamen Rider W Returns: Kamen Rider Accel
description: While settling into married life with Akiko, Ryu is brought into a case involving a woman named Katsuragi Aoi, a member of a pickpocketing ring with most of her teammates murdered from unknown masked vigilantes that Ryu fought as Accel.

title: Kamen Rider W
description: After an abundance of Gaia Memory related crimes in Fuuto, the self-proclaimed hard-boiled detective, Shotaro Hidari and the mysterious Phillip team up in order to protect the city from these Dopants - becoming Kamen Rider Double.

title: Dr. W
description: Now you are in the domains of magic and fantasy! You are surrounded by the wonders of life and you can ask as many questions as you want! You're on the Dr. W Show! Are you afraid? Are you tired? Alone? Bored??? Have you lost your faith??? Dr. W is here and has something for everyone; No matter if you are small as a microbe or as big as the universe, fast as lightning or slow as evolution, you will get something amazing! Really surprising! So try not to get too excited, try not to laugh and shout very loudly, because what you are about to see is something that you have not seen before. Welcome ... this is the Dr. W Show! Dr. Woody Bonepecker, aka Dr. W, is a delirious doctor who is always looking for the truth of the natural facts of everyday life. He is the presenter of a TV program, and in each episode he will explain to the audience different phenomena in his particular, ironic and hilarious style. Dr. W is really stubborn, he is not afraid of anything and will do anything necessary to get to the bottom of things. In his show, Dr. W uses all kinds of resources to present and explain the topics. Not only does he perform crazy experiments as a good scientist, he also appeals to the most absurd humor as if he were a clown, or to the most fantastic magic as if he were a magician. Dr. W also has the help of special guests in many episodes, as well as an enormous variety of characters that appear to help him in the development of each theme. Likewise, the live audience has a fundamental role, as it reacts to the explanations of Dr. W at all times.

title: A.W.O.L
description: Vietnam. 1972. US Army Special Forces Major Cliff Marquette leads a squad ordered to investigate unusual reports and secure a remote jungle temple locals believe has mystical powers. The Marines guarding the temple have withheld provisions for days from a Viet Cong prisoner. Despite severe mistreatment, the prisoner mysteriously shows no signs of suffering. Marquette confronts the Marine in charge, Garris for torturing a prisoner of war when suddenly enemy forces attack and mortar shells rock the temple. An exceptionally heroic, but losing battle lands Marquette in the hands of a merciless Viet Cong torturer. His men are dead; his screams unheeded. At the height of agony, Marquette's world is turned upside down. In an instant, he finds himself a stranger in the midst of an American life that apparently belongs to him - an idyllic but unrecognizable life complete with a loving wife and two children he's never seen before. Marquette struggles to take in what is happening to him. First is paranoia. Soon uncertainty and fear give way to relief and acceptance. But the twist of fate that delivered Marquette into this life from the hands of his enemy has granted him only a reprieve. The cruel pain of war is not over. As the clock strikes midnight Marquette is back in Vietnam where his torture resumes a few minutes each night. Desperately trapped between two worlds, Marquette must endure;unless, with the clock counting down, he can cheat fate. Escaping will take his wits;and it will require a gun.

title: Herbert. Barbarzynca w ogrodzie
description: Polish author Zbigniew Herbert is one of the most remarkable poets of the 20th century. His works have been translated into 40 languages, acclaimed and awarded around the world, mainly because of its timeless and universal dimension. In Poland, his significance is even greater, as Herbert was a moral guide in his native country. His poetry was of great importance during the fight against communism. Many Poles learned his poems by heart and remember them up to this day. However, behind the crystalline beauty of his poetry, there is a man struggling with everyday life. His story told by his wife, Katarzyna, and people who were close to him unveils a picture of a unique, yet complex artist. A model of intelligence, humor and charm, on the one hand, Herbert has been struggling with anger, physical pain and mental illness, on the other.

title: CelebriD&D
description: Many celebrities grew up playing role-playing games and remain avid fans and participants to this day. While excelling in their careers, their love for sword-wielding and potion-making within the realm of imagination has been put on hold... until now. CelebriD&D puts D&D-playing celebrities into a small, mini-campaign where they are paired with some of the best role-players in the world.

title: Miracle on South Street: The Julie D Story
description: In 1992, my neighbor and close family friend Julie D'Agostino was born with Cystic Fibrosis, a potentially life-threatening genetic disease. In and out of hospitals since she was a child, things took a turn for the worse right before Julie's 19th birthday. This documentary chronicles Julie and her family's life-long battle with the disease, leading up to the recent life-saving double lung transplant surgery. It also documents our neighborhood's strength as well as the support from the entire community. As a filmmaker, I felt a responsibility to tell Julie's courageous story and shed light on the importance of organ donation.

title: Rooz-e bashokooh
description: In the years before the Iranian revolution, after winning the Asian Gold Medal a bicycling champion named Gol Aqa [Ali Reza Khamseh] received an enthusiastic welcome from his compatriots when he returned to his birthplace in the City of Semnan. The government officials in his town immediately ordered that he attend a meeting about welcoming the shah's sister Ashraf Pahlavi on her arrival in the city. The district governor [Ali Nassirian] and the military and security officials asked Gol Aqa to use his popularity to persuade the people to make the carpets in their homes available to the district governor for carpeting the welcome route. Gol Aga did not agree to this but after his fiancee's brother, who was a city journalist, was abducted to provoke him, he asked the district governor and the military officials to respond and invite the people to participate. Gol Aqa's father Os Khaled [Valiyollah Shirandami] was opposed to participation by his son and the people of the town in the welcome proceedings. This was why the royal family's welcome to the city was on the same day as the wedding. The people attended the grand celebration of Gol Aqa's wedding, but the only city residents present at the welcome proceedings were the district governor and the city officials.

title: Bazgasht-e ghahraman
description: A father is informed that his son is stolen in Kurdistan and they have demand a ransom for releasing him. He manages the money and go there but when there he finds another boy rather than his own boy. He has to find a way to find his son.

title: Tashan-E-Ishq
description: The story revolves around the lives of Twinkle and Yuvraj, and their triangular relationship of love, hatred, betrayal and obsession.

title: Jaan-E-Wafa
description: Story of two friends Iqbal Jah and Nawab-Ud-Dowla. To strengthen their friendship, Iqbal Jah had arranged the marriage of his only daughter Hina with Aftab, the son of Nawab-Ud-Dowla. But suddenly, due to the interference of a Tawaif of the city by name Gauhar Jan, the friendship turns in to enmity.

title: Tabestan-e Dagh
description: A couple's son, Parham disappears in the babysitter's house. Complications arise as the babysitter claims Parham hasn't been to their house.

title: Kirdar-E-Sardar
description: The story of Kirdar-E-Sardar is based on the life of a Punjabi boxer and it defines the true spirit and power of being a Khalsa. The movie also showcases the problems of drug addiction, which is one of the perennial social evils prevalent in Punjab.

title: Nadea e Sveta
description: Nadea and Sveta is a film about friendship and complicity between migrant women. It tells a story about motherhood, love, escape from loneliness and search for home. A film between Eastern and Western Europe. Like many other Moldovan women, Nadea and Sveta moved to Italy for economic reasons. They had to leave their families back home in Moldova. Nadea's sons are grown up, whereas Sveta has left her 3-year old daughter with her grandmother. In 2010, after more than two years, Sveta can finally go back home to meet her daughter again. With her friend leaving Italy, Nadea reacts to loneliness and begins to go out in order to meet new people. The stories of the two friends will cross and their destiny will be reversed.

title: Jaan E Jahan
description: Shehraam struggles with demands from father to lead family business while holding to his morals, hesitant to fully take control.

title: Traição e Renascimento
description: Há sete anos, a filha adotiva dos meus pais, minha irmã Selene, uma delicada Ômega, ficou bêbada, atropelou alguém e fugiu, deixando sangue na Fronteira do Território Humano. Meu pai Alfa, minha mãe Luna e minha irmã biológica vieram com o mesmo pedido condescendente: 'Selene é uma Ômega. É frágil demais. Se for para a Penitenciária Lua de Prata, a loba dela não sobrevive. Lyra, vá no lugar dela. Por favor.' Eu recusei. Mas numa noite de tempestade, meu pai usou o Comando Absoluto de Alfa. Ele quebrou minha vontade, controlou minha mente e me entregou pessoalmente ao transporte da prisão. Meu noivo e Companheiro Destinado, Kaelen, o Alfa mais forte da Alcateia, conteve sua Aura de Lobo e disse: 'Lyra, quando você sair, completaremos o laço. Aguente esses sete anos por enquanto.'

title: Renascido e Invencível
description: O cientista de elite Qin Tian renasce no dia da prova. Ele abandona o exame para salvar o pai e é ridicularizado. Com habilidades de hacker, derrota um americano, resolve problemas de matemática e impressiona professores. Sua tecnologia nuclear inovadora derrota o país Mi e honra seu país!

title: Rio, 100 Degrees F.
description: A semi-documentary on the people of Rio de Janeiro. The camera follows boys from a hillside shanty town who sell peanuts at Copacabana, Sugar Loaf Mountain, and a soccer game. Various subplots, involving characters they meet along the way, are interspersed.

title: The Other F Word
description: This show is an edgy comedy about a group of friends who find that the angst of raising kids may be nothing compared to the angst of starting over after they are grown.

title: Janine F.
description: The case of Janine F. was in the press in November 2002: the 24-year-old woman jumped from the 5th floor of the famous Tacheles art house in Berlin

title: F-Zero: Farukon densetsu
description: The year is 2201 and across the universe rabid fans flock to F-Zero tracks everywhere. The prizes are enormous and the stakes grow even higher when the outlaws compete to win - at any cost. But the Elite Mobile Task Force, a team of high-risk racers, stands at the ready. Driven by a need for speed and a thirst for victory, the Task Force is determined to keep the prize money out of evil hands by defeating the menacing Black Shadow and bringing peace to the entire galaxy.

title: The F Word
description: A topical weekly show hosted by Gordon Ramsay, aided and abetted by restaurant critic Giles Coren.

title: Gundam Reconguista in G
description: The Universal Century has passed. Humanity's prosperity has ushered in a new era of global peace known as the Regild Century. Bellri Zenam, a pilot training with the Capital Guard, is chosen by the G-Self, a highly maneuverable Mobile Suit of unknown origin, operable only by a select few. These select few embark on a journey that will change the course of the Regild Century forever.

title: G-Force: Guardians of Space
description: A bird-themed superhero team battles the threat of Galactor and his minions, an international terrorist organization with advanced technology.

description: Contestants unknowingly climb into a cab and try to win money by answering questions correctly on the way to their desired location.

title: La H
description: Documentary about Argentinian thrash metal band Hermética.

title: I Promise
description: An in-depth look at the first academic year inside LeBron James' I Promise School in Akron, Ohio that opened its doors in 2018.

title: And I Ride and I Ride
description: Musician and Kat Onoma band leader until 2004, Rodolphe Berger lives as if he had nine lives. He's had many determining if paradoxical meetings, with artists or fameless and workless characters, to the point of sabotaging himself sometimes. He kept on going no matter what, transfiguring rock music, mixing his own intimate story with some history of music, a story of people with a story of places. He kept going towards a destination he didn't necessarily want to know about. We only know where his home bases are: Sainte-Marie-aux-Mines, Paris, Batz Island. We only know that it all stems from something - that his personal path took him from philosophy to music.

description: Intimate portrayal of the events captured by the ordinary people on September 11.

title: I Wish I Were Stephanie V
description: 3 girls, 3 immigrant families, 3 romances, 1 tennis final. Told by Helen, a 21 year old virgin being raised by her matchmaking Greek grandmother.

title: I Fshehuri
description: Drama based on a true story, where a married couple faced with a problem that the science describes as parapsychology phenomena but among the religious people is known as demonic possession.

title: I efoplistina
description: A poor girl that makes a living out of selling baked goods on the street suddenly becomes a rich heiress and her life turns upside down, as she has to deal both with her dead father's antagonists and the life she left behind.

title: I soldi
description: On the theme "money is the driving force that drives man to commit follies to conquer them", this film presents a series of episodes.

title: I Belong
description: What happens to us when people stop acting like they're supposed to? A nurse gets into a dispute at work because she switches to speaking English when she gets nervous. A translator compromises her integrity when persuaded to translate a book she doesn't believe in. An elderly woman and her daughter are humiliated when offered a present of one million kroner from a relative. I Belong is a warm and nuanced film about people who all mean well, but end up hurting one another. About how people who act on integrity and feelings are seen as troublesome in a society where the ideal is to behave rationally. A playful tragedy-comedy about how what seems like something of little importance to one person, can seem like a grand disaster to another.

title: I Confess
description: A priest who comes under suspicion for murder cannot clear his name without breaking the seal of the confessional.

title: Evil, I
description: Evil I explores the dark corners of sinister minds from two distinct perspectives. A dramatization of a killer's voice guides you through his murderous acts, while investigators pick up harrowing clues in their quest to bring him to justice.

title: I Vow
description: A couple with a secret. The struggles of co-parenting. The pressure of having kids. A marriage on the rocks. These are four unique stories about navigating the beautiful and challenging journey of marriage.

title: I, Scorpio
description: An experimental narrative exploring the relationship that develops between a Mexican hitchhiker and a drug dealer that he meets on a desert road in 1974.

title: i-Lived
description: A young online app reviewer's latest assignment mysteriously improves his life, but also starts to tear him apart.

title: I dada
description: A woman decides to work as nanny in the house of a rich theater director and his three children.

title: I peripterou
description: A good-hearted taxi driver dreams of living comfortably and rich. In her attempt to help people, she upsets her little neighborhood.

title: I Do
description: The stories of four couples who are all spending their honeymoon night in the same hotel.

title: I Do
description:
All her life, Yumi (Erich Gonzales) has been fantasizing about her dream wedding. Then she meets and falls in love with Lance (Enchong Dee), who comes from a strict Filipino-Chinese family. With their completely opposite backgrounds, plus plenty of unexpected obstacles, will their love last long enough for that dream wedding? Released in 2010 and directed by Veronica B. Velasco.

Starring Erich Gonzales, Enchong Dee, Dennis Padilla, and Pokwang.

title: I Versus I
description: Dr. Eloy Cron, pioneer of a technology that can instantaneously transports objects, decides to test his work on a human subject, himself. But during the transmission, he finds himself trapped inside his own transport capsule, while a doppelganger exits the other.

title: I Think I Cannes
description: Ala "Roger & Me", a young woman goes to Cannes and gets rejected at every turn.

title: I Loved, I Bled, I Let Go
description: Frankie, a musical prodigy, sacrificed everything to make his wife Sophie a star, only to be cast aside like a forgotten melody.Betrayed and broken, he died in obscurity—until he awoke twenty years in the past. This time, he'll harness his genius for himself, ascending to heights Sophie could never imagine. As his symphonies dominate the world, she and their kids, who have forgotten him, are left with a haunting question:Was their betrayal worth losing a legend?

title: If I Should Die Before I Wake
description: Brian Edwards has his career, home life and reputation torn asunder as he surrenders to the advances of the teenage Christian Egan. The outcome of their affair nearly costs both of these characters their lives.

title: Oli i doxa... Oli i hari...
Before I Was Born, I Planned Revenge
description: In her past life, Ellie was shamed as a bastard by her biased father and ultimately murdered by his beloved mistress. After death, she learns her world was a novel, and she was only a disposable character. Reborn in her mother's womb, Ellie plots from before birth. Using foresight and cunning, she wins the trust of the head of the Grant family, exposes a poisoning scheme, and drives her enemies out, securing justice and a future for herself and her mother.

title: I, Timon
description: Shakespeare's forgotten masterpiece of a good man in an evil world.

title: I Work
description: A confused anarchist and his workaholic housemate set out to find an estranged parent. The two get more than they bargained for, when an accident along the way reveals wires beneath their skin.

title: I Have a Secret
description: A young woman recovering from abuse grapples with loss and pursues life without fear and shame.

title: Forbidden Love [Urdu]
description: Rich Adnan marries Bihter, who is younger than him. A poisonous forbidden love begins between Adnan's nephew Behlül and Bihter who lives in the same mansion.

title: Wisdom: Book I
description:
Wisdom is not just a matter of mentally understanding ideas. Wisdom is a revelation of the sacred, an experience of the divine, a knowing that includes your heart as well as your mind.

In Wisdom: Book I, author Jared Stuart shares the spiritual insights hes discovered during his faith journey. From a young age, the author sought to know God and to receive Wisdom by practicing Christianity. But though his intentions ran very deep, he struggled to experience the truth in his heart. It wasnt until he began to look at God through the mystical lens of Kabbalah that he began to truly understand Wisdom and the Creator.

This book is extraordinary in its approach to spiritual matters. Rather than dogmatically dictating a singular conclusion, the author draws from both Christianity and Kabbalah, letting the Voice of Wisdom welcome readers from all religions, beliefs, and creeds. The development of Wisdom in ones life is not without its challenges, but in the end it is more about relationship than compliance. This inspiring book guides willing readers to seek answers to lifes big questions so that they can begin to understand the timeless truths that are foundational to being human.

title: Dans l'ombre
description: Melanie, a newly separated mother, is spending a weekend at her mother's house with Tom, her 8-year-old son who is still unaware of the breakup. In the shadows, a creature in search of fresh flesh lies in wait for them, examines them and searches for their loophole in order to lure them into its lair.

title: Summer of 36
description: Nice, 1936. The elite vacationing on the Côte d'Azur are disturbed by workers enjoying their first paid holidays. Four women from different classes become entangled in a murder at the luxurious Riviera Hotel.

title: A Quiet Man
description: On the esplanade of La Défense, a man in a suit wanders about, lost. He has just been dismissed and he hasn't gone home. From one of the high towers of the business district, his former colleagues observe him and wonder why he is still there, and what he may have in mind.

title: (M)OTHER
description: What makes a human being a real mother? Director Antonia Hungerland embarks on a personal quest to find out what motherhood means to her personally.

title: M.L.A. Fatakesto
description: A small time goon becomes a member of the legislative assembly; the story depicts a week in his life.

title: Dial M for Music
description: Saturday afternoon music program, with an emphasis on jazz.

title: Ed, Edd n Eddy
description: The off-the-wall, day-to-day life of three friends who have exactly the same name.

title: Athina - N. Yorki: To megalo kolpo
description: A Greek gym-owner in New York, Michalis, is forced to ask for a loan from the richest man in Astoria, Antonis, who has connections with the underworld. Antonis also has a daughter, Martha, who is involved with the son of his friend Charis. Antonis willingly gives him the loan, without knowing, however, that his son-in-law Nikos, husband of his eldest daughter Elli, is using Michalis in a major scam to steal the money he has withheld from the internal revenue service. When Apergis' plan is completed and Antonis asks for the money owed, Michalis closes down the gym and leaves for Greece. Then, Antonis follows him to Athens, where he finds out about the entire plot. He also discovers that Nikos was one of the robbers of a bank in New York, which he was planning to flee with his young lover. Antonis apologizes to Michalis and allows his daughter to marry the man she loves.

title: Miopía, cantad al rock n' roll
Vice nalungkot sa kuwento ni nanay Rea
description:
Blessings have arrived kaya saluhin mo nang may ngiti sa mga labi. Five pogi heartthrobs have also arrived sa "It's Showtime" studio kaya times five ang kilig na sasakop sa puso n'yo!

Itinanghal na New Group Artist of the Year ng PPOP Music Awards 2025, WRIVE is here para haranahin ang Madlang People with their track "Hakbang." Espesyal rin ang araw na 'to dahil may espesyal na pagbati ng maligayang kaarawan para kay WRIVE Drei. At hindi lang si Drei ang may wish, syempre, lahat sila may big goals na gustong ma-achieve. Saan ba wish 'humakbang' ng grupo?

Mula Hinulugang Taktak, magfo-fall ang swerte papunta sa mga madlang players na sumalang sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena. Kaya makisakay na rin sa trip ng mga taga-Antipolo na naglaro!

Agaw-pansin ang nakaka-good vibes na awra ni player Rea, isang caddie sa golf club kung saan naglalaro si Ryan Bang. Ang ating oppa, nabigla sa pambubuking ni Rea, na sinabing galante siya at "mahilig sa magandang caddie." Napangiti na lang si Ryan, sabay depensa sa sarili, "Hindi ako 'yun!"

Pero pagkatapos ng tawanan at kulitan, naging seryso ang usapan nang ibahagi ni Rea ang hirap na pagkasyahin ang sweldo nila ni mister, na isang construction worker. Hindi raw maiwasan na paulit-ulit mangutang para sa pangangailangan ng tatlong anak. Naalala tuloy ni Vice Ganda ang isang eksena nila ni Nadine Lustre sa "Call Me Mother" kung saan bumitaw siya ng linya tungkol sa pagiging ina.

Nang makita naman ni Meme si player Louie, parang nakaharap daw niya ang kanyang kabataan, na parang kombinasyon din nilang tatlo nina Vhong Navarro at Jhong Hilario! Dahil parang tropa na ang vibe ng apat, tinulungan nila si Louie na manligaw on national TV!

Mirror, mirror on the wall, who is the luckiest of them all? Si Cecille ang luckiest player na sumabak sa jackPOT round. Pero bago ang tawaran, napansin ni Vice Ganda ang 'costume' nina Karylle at Kim Chiu, na parehong may "injury." Biro ni Jhong Hilario, kung may BINI, sina Karylle at Kim naman ang BINA, as in BINAlot ng benda.

Itinodo ng BINA girls ang Li-Pot offer na umabot sa P35,000. Sa kabila ng pangungumbinsi ng Vice na subukan ang POT, mas pinili ni Cecille ang Li-Pot. Good decision! Kaya, Ate Cecille, congratulations!

Patuloy ang salpukan ng mga pambato ng NCR sa unang linggo na 'Tawag Ng Tanghalan Ika-10 Taon.'

Ang matinding bosesan, sinimulan ng pambato ng Caloocan na si Georgina Medina. Tinig niyang makabago, binigyang buhay ang "Love" ni Keyshia Cole sa entablado.

Tiwala sa sarili ay nais ibalik ni Kane Gabriel ng Mandaluyong City na buong-pusong inawit ang "You Will Be Found." Si Kane, may 'di magandang karanasan nang mag-perform sa isang big stage, kaya pakiusap ni Punong Hurado Louie Ocampo, magpatuloy lang ito sa pagkanta, "Don't give up because you have a beautiful voice." Paliwanag ni Maestro Louie, malakas ang dating ni Kane bilang mang-aawit, pero kailangan na maging maingat sa paglakas ng volume.

Sa dulo, itinanghal na panalo si Georgina sa score na 91.3%, laban sa 88.3% ni Kane.

title: Hashire! T-kô Basket bu
description: Yoichi plays basketball at his junior high and is capable. He is granted a scholarship and attends a high school with a superlative basket team. Instead of welcoming the boy the students there decide to bully and harass the new player leading Yoichi to a new high school and basketball team. Expectedly, the basketball team is not the best. The team will have to soon play against the team from the school Yoichi was in before.

description: After a personal tragedy, a father and son stay at a secluded cabin during a hunting trip when they discover a mysterious set of rules and are forced to face their fears and attempt to survive.

title: The Billy T. James Show

title: Traveling with Mr. T.
description: Writing. Love. Pain. Nothing in Troels' life is small or easy. He dreams, thinks and feels in capital letters. Troels is approaching 30, with very little to show for it. His successful, well-meaning friends take action and make Troels sign a contract. He is to finish his book, 'Travelling with Mr. T' within one year. Troels is determined to do so, but his alter ego Mr. T is taking over. Mr. T sees pain and drunkenness as the keys to writing. The project that was supposed to help Troels find direction in his life, is leading him off track...

title: The T
description: Jo, a white trans woman craving an increasingly elusive intimacy, Carter, a queer Black man at odds with his conservative upbringing, and Emerie, a Latina trans woman stuck in an incompatible relationship, all converge from different parts of Chicago for a magical New Year's Eve night. As hangovers fade, and the three friends face awkward hook-ups, nervous dates, and the unlikely pursuit of lasting love, at least they have each other.

title: T-Pain's School of Business
description: First, he mastered hip-hop. Now T-Pain takes us into the world of young disruptors, revealing the most innovative and exciting players in the entrepreneurial game. Quirky dreamers and passionate doers meet their biggest cheerleader. T-Pain.

title: Don't Look Back in Anger
description: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

title: A Bolsa Ou a Vida
description: In the post-pandemic future of covid-19, which alternative will be given more attention: the financial casino and the accumulation of wealth by an elite or quality life for all, with less inequality? Has the minimal state proved capable of serving the collective? How can life be guaranteed without social and labor rights? What model of society do we want to live in? The film addresses the dismantling of the concept of social welfare and makes us reflect on the incompatibility of neoliberalism with a humanist project for society.

title: A Poet a City and a Footballer
description: A documentary chronicling a dying Bengali film-maker making a film on legendary football player P.K. Banerjee on the back drop of city of joy Calcutta.

title: A Lawyer Walks Into a Bar...

title: What a Difference a Day Makes
description: The successful politician Robert is going on a romantic weekend trip with his pregnant girlfriend Katharina as a unexpected old friend of Robert,Wolfgang suddenly appears on the surface and start to stalk the couple.

title: Married a Gardener, Got a Prince
description: Prince Philip of the young Kingdom of Lavinia went to the US to avoid being pressured into marriage. There he met and helped Anna, an American girl who had just been betrayed by her boyfriend. Philip claimed to be a royal gardener and agreed to a flash marriage with Anna. After their marriage, the two worked together to take on Anna's stepmother and stepsister, helping Anna successfully inherit her mother's company and obtain the authorization for royal portraits. In the end, Philip revealed his true identity, got his parents to accept Anna, and the two lived a happy life in California.

title: André, a Cara e a Coragem
description: Country boy arrives in Rio de Janeiro, looking for a better life, but he finds it extremely difficult to get a job, and even has to work as a pimp in order to survive.

title: Lose a Girl Score a Boy

title: A Method to a Sweet Science

title: A Febre

title: Does a Tiger Wear a Necktie?
description: Does a Tiger Wear a Necktie? The screenplay is adapted from the play written by Don Petersen. It launched the career of Al Pacino, who won a Tony Award for Best Dramatic Actor in a Supporting Role, for his portrayal of Bickham. Newsweek said that Pacino had "the choreography of a heroin hood, with a poetic soul." Variety named Pacino the "most promising new Broadway actor" for his performance. The story is a characterized documentary about the lives of addicts and our rehabilitation system. It portrays heroin addicts as the victims of loveless upbringings and does not provide morality or solutions. It leaves judgement to the viewer. Does a Tiger Wear a Necktie? takes place in the 1960's at a detention center on an island in a river bordering a large industrial city.

title: A Century's Love, A Prince's Price
description:
Genesis Williams, a 21st-century college student, accidentally time-travels to the Dashia Dynasty and meets Charles Diaz, the Ninth Prince. Smitten by Charles, Genesis performs a hundred good deeds for him in a daring attempt to defy destiny. Through shared life-and-death trials, they pledged their undying love. But in the seventh year of their marriage, Charles Diaz suddenly falls for Mia Miller, the princess of Nomadia Borealis. Not only does he plan to marry Mia, but he also bestows upon her the exclusive affection once reserved solely for Genesis.
Discovering that a rare celestial phenomenon will reopen the time portal in seven days—offering her a chance to return to her own era—Genesis resolves to perform one final act for Charles before leaving. However, his ultimate demand shatters her world: he asks for her very eyes...

title: A Baby's Adventure and A Wife's Awakening
description: A celestial being with the power of a nine-tailed spirit fox is reborn as a mortal baby. To regain immortality, she must earn good karma through good deeds. Labeled a “demon child” by her father, she is unexpectedly understood by her mother, who can hear her thoughts. Together, they uncover the father’s betrayal and the mistress’s schemes, breaking free from abuse. In the end, the mother escapes, and the child rises as a blessed star through accumulated karma.

title: Novia a la Fuga, Bebé a bordo
description: Después de ser drogado, Eason, un poderoso CEO, pasa la noche con Chloe, inconsciente de su identidad. Cuando sus caminos vuelven a encuentrar, Eason, al no reconocer a Chloe, la contrata como su secretaria. Mientras trabaja para él, Chloe descubre que está embarazada de su hijo. Justo cuando está asimilando esta situación, Eason, desesperado por salvar a su abuela, acepta casarse con Maura, rompiendo el corazón de Chloe. Al negarse a revelar la identidad del padre, Chloe agranda la brecha entre ellos. Pero la situación se vuelve aún más oscura cuando Maura, decidida a mantener a Chloe alejada de Eason, mata a la madre de Chloe y la amenaza para que se mantenga alejada.

title: Sweet Teeth [Hindi]
description: Dentist Ai Jing Chu, who also teaches at Donghu University, is known to be the most handsome man at school. University librarian Zeng Li, however, is prejudiced against him because of a little misunderstanding. When Zeng Li's mother forces her to get braces, she tries to avoid Ai Jing Chu at all costs, but eventually still ends up becoming his patient. As the two interact more and more with each other, Zeng Li realizes that Ai Jing Chu is actually a very professional and caring person, and starts to develop feelings for him.

title: Level E [English]
description: In the present day, hundreds of extraterrestrial species walk the Earth. Some are pacifistic, others violent. Some are here for research purposes, others are career criminals. However, humans don't know they are here. Now, one more alien has arrived on Earth. One of the universe's foremost geniuses with a personality that's bound to attract all sorts of trouble.

title: I Wish I Never Knew You
description: Claire Harris, from a humble background, fell sincerely in love with Victor Carter. Victor promised to devote his life solely to her and marry her as his primary wife. However, within five years, Claire received news that Victor would wed Violet Sawyer to strengthen his influence. Seeing Victor lavish all the former tenderness on Violet, Claire became completely disillusioned. She chose to leave Pingyang City for good, ensuring Victor would never locate her.

title: I ypografi
description: Anna, a young art historian is preparing a retrospective of the work of the famous painter, Maria Dimou. She is assisted by Angelos, an old friend of the painter. Dimou was found dead several years ago. Her death is not clear: suicide or murder ? Angelos will help Anna solve this mystery but Angelos has many things to hide...

title: I Hrysomallousa
description: The teacher of a village in Zakynthos, trying to react to the alienation of the village, mobilizes his villagers to put on a play and falls in love with the widow of an immigrant.

title: I epistrofi
description: A fatal love triangle. Ilias, already sixty years old, returns to his almost deserted village in Greece after thirty years of hard labor in the factories of Germany. He purchases a gas-station and a restaurant located on the main highway towards Ioannina and wishes to make a new start. He feels a stranger once more, only this time in his own country. Eleni, his wife, is twenty years younger, and still pretty. Even though she never fell in love with him, they married when she was very young, hoping that he will put her out of the poverty and the misery of the village.The perspective of being condemned to spend the rest of her life in this deserted village fills her with desperation. She simply wants to live her life, while there's still time. Petros is an Albanian illegal immigrant who arrives in Greece seeking for a better future. Ilias saves him from the authorities and hires him to work at his restaurant. An unusual father and son relationship emerges between them, whereas, at the same time, Eleni and Petros fall desperately in love until the tragic finale.

title: I familia
description: A couple, after several years of living together, four children, a job, obligations and all the big and small things that everyday life has, decides to go to a marriage psychologist-counselor.

title: Le Jour J

title: Sju Kammers - Frontsøstrene
description: In Purcells opera Dido and Aenaes, Dido ends her own life with the words "Remember me, but forget my faith." Solace embodies this lament with women silenced by war, united in a choice they made when they were young. Through separate chapters we meet six women who once worked as Red Cross nurses at the Eastern Front. During WWII thousands of European women volunteered to the war zones to serve as nurses for the German Red Cross. In the front lines they cared for wounded German soldiers - and soldiers of other nationalities. These women became known as the Front sisters. On the journey back home after the war had ended they survived through a war-harried Germany. Many returned traumatised and would be socially harassed by their community. In Norway they were imprisoned for treason, condemned for saving the wrong lives. Solace is a film about young women who went out with a desire to help, for later to be associated with some of the most gruesome acts of the twentieth century. At the end of the road they finally dare to reveal some of their innermost painful memories, letting us in to their long-time secrete rooms for the first time.

In the village of São João do Rio do Peixe they come to Sítio Araçás, a rural community of 86 families, mostly relatives. With a girl from Araçás as mediator, the residents, in their majority, elderly, tell their life story, marked by popular catholicism, by a hierarchy, by a sense of family and honor - in a world fast disappearing.

Porém, ele acaba envolvido na guerra entre Ironmark e os demônios. Para impedir a destruição do reino, Ronan empunha seu martelo mutável com poder divino e enfrenta os demônios ao lado da princesa Seraphina e aliados das Casas Nobres.

title: Segunda Chance: O Caminho para o Bilhão
description: Na vida passada, Henrique usou os quatro milhões ganhos na loteria para fingir ser herdeiro e entrar na elite. Achou que conhecer poderosos mudaria seu destino, mas, dez anos depois, foi desmascarado e humilhado em público. Ao despertar, descobre que renasceu e voltou ao verão do último ano escolar. Com os quatro milhões, lucra com oportunidades na madeira, nos futuros de borracha e no petróleo. Desta vez, não vai fingir ser rico: vai construir a própria fortuna do zero!

title: Emma Tiglao umupo bilang Miss Q and A hurado
description:
I-on ang playlist at maki-sound trip with hip-hop artist J Rose, na ipinarinig ang bago niyang single at ibinahagi ang kuwento sa likod nito.

Makitawa naman sa mga kandidatang laban na laban sa Miss Q and A. Sa kanilang mga talak, atensyon mo'y mahahatak! Palaban sa puksaan sina Andrea Lim ng Pampanga, Rhian Orain ng Valenzuela, at Pau Chiu ng Manila.

Ang pangalan ni Candidate No. 3, inspired by Chinita Princess Kim Chiu, na 'peg' niya at idolo. Pero sa paningin ni Vice Ganda, hindi naman si Kim ang kanyang nakikita. Para bang deja vu, namalikmata si Meme at nakita si Tado! Biro niya, "Si Candidate #3 ay nakaaway ko no'ng Season 1." Baka ito na nga ang 'closure' na inaabangan.

Hirit ni Meme, "Mga bakla, aral-aral din." Pero sa hinaba-haba man ng kulitan, may dalwang kandidata na umabante sa second round, at ito ay sina Andrea at Pau. Ang tanong kay Andrea, "Papayag ka ba na marami kang pera pero na kay Vice Ganda?" At si Pau naman, natanong kung papayag siyang maging doktor kahit madali siyang mahawa ng mga sakit.

Pagkatapos ng WIT Lang, si Andrea ang pinusuan nina hurado Karylle, Brent Manalo, at Miss Grand International 2025 Emma Tiglao, at itinanghal na Reyna TalakEra of the day.

Sa araw na 'to, mga taga-Mahabang Parang, Angono Rizal ang bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Kapag nagsama-sama naman ang Showtime hosts sa 'You Gotta Lyric' round, ibig sabihin, masaya ang aktingan. Si Lassy, pinagtulungan na buhatin. Teka, saan n'yo siya dalahen?

Best friends ni Christian ang mga alagang baboy dahil sila ang nagdadala sa kanya ng swerte at kabuhayan. Kaya 'pag nakuha niya ang P100,000 sa paglalaro sa jackpot round, ang mga alagang baboy, sure na madadagdagan.

title: Kandidata, may matinding pinagdadaanan sa Miss Q&A
description:
Bumisita ngayong maulan na Wednesday ang bandang Hilera, na ibinandera ang OPM punk rock genre sa kanta nilang "Diretso." Ipinakilala rin ng banda ang bago nilang miyembro.

Kumpleto muli ang energetic trio nina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario, na sinimulan ng Miss Q and A sa puksaan ng OOTD... at odor?!

Tuloy-tuloy naman ang puksaan sa rampahan as the Miss Q and A candidates walked the runway in their pakak-tail dresses. Nagpakilala sina Stacey Doroteo, Jillian Indefonso, at Queen Mortel. At bago ang paunahan sa pagsagot ng trivia questions sa Tumapk Ganern round, kinilatis muna ang ladies sa kanilang talent at energy.

Kung si Stacey ay pinagkakakitaan ang husay sa pagsasalita bilang host, hirit ni Meme, 'yung iba pinagkakakitaan ang bibig sa maling paraan katulad ng pagkakalat ng chismis at fake news. No, no 'yan! Heto ang hindi fake news, si Queen Mortel, may pinagdadaanan. Kaya naman ang hosts, sumuko na lang matapos mag-fail na ilabas ang highest energy ni Queen.

Epic fail in the funniest way naman ang sagot ng mga 'accla' sa mga tanong sa unang round, katulad ng tanong na may kinalaman sa matamis na syrup sa taho, Filipino term para sa petal, at pangalan ni Mars Ravelo.

Sa hinaba-haba man ng hulaan, sa Wit Lang pa rin ang tuloy nina Stacey at Queen Mortel. Ang nabunot na tanong ni Stacey, "Anong mas mahirap i-maintain, relasyon o bank bank balance?" Tumapat naman kay Queen Mortel ang tanong na, "Alin ang mas nakakagising ng group chat, 'yung bagong tsismis o 'yung may nag-leave sa group?"

Kung suspended ang klase, ’wag munang malungkot. Ang mga college students from Pasay, sa "It's Showtime" muna pumasok. At ang activity nila, mag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakipagkuwentuhan sina Vice Ganda, Karylle, at Ogie Alcasid sa mga bisitang etsudyante. As they get to know the students, mas napansin ni Vice na para bang nawawala na ang sense of curiosity ng mga kabataan, kaya pinaalalahanan niya ang mga estudyante na maging curious sa paligid at palawakin ang kaalaman.

Samantala, kung bibigyan ni teacher ng grade ang mga eksena sa You Gotta Lyric, siguradong lahat ay makakamartsa sa entablado dahil sa aktingan na pasado. Si Jackie Gonzaga, biglang

nag-transform in the middle of her scene with Cianne Dominguez, kaya hirit ni Meme Vice, "I love the plot twist!"

Heto ang plot twist in life na hinihintay ni Zie, ang Business Administration student na umabante sa jackpot round. Sinugalan ni Zie ang P250,000 POT question ngunit bigo itong maibigay ang tamang sagot sa tanong na, "Anong instrumento ang ginagamit sa pagsukat ng bilis ng hangin?"

Hindi pa rin siya uuwing luhaan dahil sa P5,000 ayuda mula kay Vice Ganda.

title: Vice walang tiwala sa 'MUKHA' ni Miss Q&A Freda
description:
Pak na pak ang mga kandidatang tumalak sa Miss Q and A Weekly Finals. Dahil sa malakas na cheer ng Madang People, napa-"and I thank you" sina Elthon Bequio, Trixie Gomez, Gabriela Duevall, Queen Sam Ri, Freda, at Kathryn Fernando Poe, Jr.

Ang mga accla, nagbardagulan at bumuo ng kani-kanilang grupo. Pero at the end of the competition, nangingibabaw pa rin sa kanila ang nahanap na bagong sisterhood... at may nahanap din na pag-ibig? Si Gabriela, na-love at first sight sa 'poganda' na si Queen Sam Ri. At totoo ba ang balita na may isang lasing na kandidata?!

Ang Top 4 na sina Sam Ri, Elthon, Freda, at Gabriela ang umabante sa Wit Lang round. At mula sa apat, dalawa lang ang nag-face off sa Beklamation. It's Sam Ri versus Elthon sa katanungan na, "Sa panahon ngayon anong mas nakakatakot, katangahan o kasamaan?"

Talak ni Sam Ri, mas nakakatakot ang katangahan dahil ito ang dahilan kung bakit marami ang nabibiktima ng fake news. "May mga taong matatalino pero nagtatanga-tangahan kaya nadadakip sila at napapaniwala ng mali," sabi ni Sam Ri.

Mula NCR, sumugod sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ang Madlang Players na nangtatrabaho sa printing shops. May isang player ba na magpapa-tarpaulin ng "congrats" dahil na-hit ang jackpot?

Ay, nakaka-in love talaga! Nakisali pa sweet-sweet-an sina Darren Espanto at Jackie Gonzaga, na pinakilig ang Madlang People sa kanilang 'rainy moment' na eksena!

Pagkatapos ng It's Giving, You Gotta Lyric, at Laro Laro Pick rounds, ang joy ay kumapit kay player Joy.

title: The R&B Feeling
description: 1971, the Los Angeles performance art scene is flourishing. Chris Burden has just ordered a studio assistant to shoot him in the left arm with a rifle, Barbara T Smith is staging provocative interventions at F-Space, and Paul McCarthy is painting his naked body with mustard and ketchup in the name of art. And among them all, Bob Parks: an energetic young artist from the UK, living with his beautiful and interesting San Fransiscan wife, Myriam Morales. Life is perfect, for a time. But when Bob's marriage fails, and Myriam leaves for Santa Fe, things fall apart. He walks the streets of Los Angeles for a year in a string bikini and sees his burgeoning art career come to pieces. Having been rescued by the parishioners of a South Central gospel church, and having spent six years worshipping and singing alongside them, Bob finally moves back to the UK to live with his parents in the New Forest. Despite planning to stay for only six months to finish a series of paintings and gather his thoughts, Bob stays for thirty years. We meet him as he continues to develop his art practice, continues to sing in a gospel church and continues to explore what he calls "the R&B feeling". Against this backdrop, Bob attempts to break free of a constraining and mutually dependent relationship with his mother, Miggie, whose health is failing. As time goes on Bob's obsession with his mother - and her impending death - deepens, before reaching a terrible and tragic conclusion.

title: S Is for Sexy
description: Seven Sexy and Smart Short Gay Films: Serene Hunter (France) Set in Paris, the 'hunter' of the title is a 30-something gay male who has a string of one-night stands. Content being free and unfettered by relationships, he happily moves from encounter to encounter. He then surprises himself by becoming involved in a more substantial relationship...but can the hunter within him be tamed? An honest portrayal, with some explicit action. Solace (US) This film shows an older and younger man who meet on the internet, and seem to get along well, until the older man tells about his boyfriend and it shatters younger man's dreams. Scarred (UK) An early 20s male has a significant scar on his face from a knife wound - and is fed up of the unwanted attention that it attracts. Will he find someone who can see past the scar? The answer may lie with an older, middle-aged architect, who seems to be the one person to whom the scar is invisible. Signage (US) Middle age can be hidden somewhat with makeup and hair coloring, which encourages two best friends to plan a night out at a bar that caters to young men half their age. One makes a strong connection with a young deaf guy, only to find out that there is more than one type of obstacle involved. Mr_Right_22 (Germany) First-date jitters in the age of internet dating but a kind waiter calms his fears and offers some encouragement to be open to life's opportunities. Cute. 41 Seconds (Germany) Two masculine friends take about "41 Seconds" to compare notes on one of their dates, in which his girlfriend compared their respective skills as a kisser. Only 4 minutes, but cute. Shahram and Abbas (Netherlands) Two Iranian refugees, a young student activist and an older journalist, who want to see political asylum in the Netherlands. Believing they have a better chance of being granted such if they claim to be a persecuted homosexual couple, they begin a charade that leads to complications they never imagined, especially when the younger Shahram falls for a woman also awaiting asylum. Powerful and positive depiction of a very sad and serious situation.

title: White T
description: Herbert and Henry (Jerod and Jamal Mixon) are twin brothers who dream of becoming the biggest rap stars in the game. Their chance at superstardom comes after they buy a T-shirt with a winning golden tag that allows them to perform Real Deal, the most legendary rapper in the world. However, Kevin, a Jewish kid their same size with dreams of singing and blinging manages to steal the prized Whit T and has his own plans to perform at the concert. With help from a gypsy, a goat, and cast of characters as big as Herbert and Henry's appetites, White T is a feel-good urban adventure reminiscent of "Dude. Where's My Car?", "Harold and Kumar Go to White Castle", and "Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory."
